jobs.description:

AG Consulting Partners is seeking a highly skilled, hands-on **Senior Technical Program Manager – Power Platform & Automation** to support a Responsible AI (RAI) program within a large enterprise technology environment.

This is an exciting opportunity for a technically strong problem solver who enjoys building solutions, improving processes, and driving meaningful operational improvements. The ideal candidate brings a combination of technical development, business analysis, automation, and program management experience, with the ability to independently take initiatives from concept through implementation.

This role is approximately **80% focused on technical development, automation, reporting, and operational improvements**, with the remaining 20% supporting Responsible AI governance and impact assessment activities.

We're looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes ownership, and is comfortable rolling up their sleeves to solve complex technical and business challenges.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, enhance, and maintain business applications and automated workflows using Power Apps and Power Automate.
* Build solutions to streamline intake processes, case management, assessment workflows, and operational activities.

* Support application configuration, testing, maintenance, and enhancements, including solutions leveraging Dataverse.

* Communicate progress, risks, and recommendations effectively to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

* Develop and maintain operational dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI or similar technologies.
* Analyze data to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Investigate reporting issues and improve data quality across applications and workflows.
* Support Responsible AI impact assessments, governance reviews, and related operational processes.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, document findings, and identify potential risks related to privacy, security, and Responsible AI principles.

* Experience translating business requirements into technical specifications, process improvements, and functional solutions.
* Strong program and project management skills, with experience managing multiple priorities and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently in ambiguous environments, establish direction, and deliver results with limited oversight.
* Strong analytical thinking and understanding of interconnected systems, applications, and data flows.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including technical documentation and stakeholder presentations.
* A hands-on mindset and willingness to contribute to both technical development and detailed operational activities.

**You might also have:**

* Experience developing solutions using Dataverse.
* Experience building dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI.
* Familiarity with SQL, APIs, data integrations, or related technologies.
* Experience developing AI-enabled workflows, AI agents, or solutions using Copilot Studio or comparable technologies.
* Exposure to Responsible AI, privacy, compliance, technology risk management, or governance processes.
* Experience working within large enterprise technology environments.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

**Work Where it Matters**

RiverTech, an Akima company, is not just another federal professional solutions contractor. As an Alaska Native Corporation (ANC), our mission and purpose extend beyond our exciting federal projects as we support our shareholder communities in Alaska.

At RiverTech, the work you do every day makes a difference in the lives of our 15,000 Iñupiat shareholders, a group of Alaska natives from one of the most remote and harshest environments in the United States.

**For our shareholders**, RiverTech provides support and employment opportunities and contributes to the survival of a culture that has thrived above the Arctic Circle for more than 10,000 years.

**For our government customers**, RiverTech provides innovative solutions to complex engineering and operational challenges and delivers wide-ranging services for mission support, systems engineering, and IT.

**As a RiverTech employee,** you will be surrounded by a challenging, yet supportive work environment that is committed to innovation and diversity, two of our most important values. You will also have access to our comprehensive benefits and competitive pay in addition to growth opportunities and excellent retirement options.

Description:

The Program Manager (PM) / Subject Matter Expert (SME) serves as the senior regional leader responsible for the overall management, execution, quality assurance, and performance of Enterprise Systems Management support services provided to the Strategic Army Network Enterprise Center (SANEC) across Texas, Oklahoma, and surrounding geographic areas. The PM serves as the contractor's principal representative and regional technical authority, providing direct oversight of contract operations, personnel, and mission support requirements throughout the assigned region. In this capacity, the PM acts as the primary interface between contractor personnel, Government leadership, the Contracting Officer (KO), and the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), ensuring contractual requirements, operational objectives, and established performance standards are consistently achieved.

Serving in a dual capacity as both Program Manager and regional Subject Matter Expert, the individual provides strategic leadership, technical expertise, operational oversight, quality management, and workforce supervision across geographically dispersed installations and supported organizations. The PM is responsible for coordinating enterprise IT operations, systems management initiatives, technical solutions, process improvements, and mission-critical network services throughout the region. This position requires extensive Department of Defense IT management experience, comprehensive knowledge of enterprise network operations, and demonstrated ability to oversee multiple concurrent projects, resolve complex technical and operational challenges, and ensure consistent service delivery across geographically separated locations. The PM also serves as a trusted technical advisor to Government stakeholders, providing recommendations, operational assessments, and strategic guidance to enhance mission readiness, service effectiveness, and overall contract performance.

Responsibilities:

* Serve as the primary Regional Program Manager and senior technical SME responsible for the successful execution, management, and performance of Enterprise Systems Management support services across Texas, Oklahoma, and surrounding geographic locations.

* Oversee daily contract operations to ensure compliance with the Performance Work Statement (PWS), contractual requirements, established performance metrics, and applicable Department of Defense and Army regulations.
* Develop, implement, and maintain program management processes, operational procedures, and performance improvement initiatives to ensure consistent service delivery throughout the assigned region.
* Coordinate resources, personnel, schedules, and operational priorities across multiple locations to ensure effective execution of mission requirements.

### **Technical Leadership and Subject Matter Expertise:**

* Serve as the senior regional technical advisor and SME for enterprise IT operations, systems administration, network management, cybersecurity, and associated IT infrastructure support services.
* Provide technical guidance and oversight for complex IT infrastructure challenges, system performance issues, network outages, and enterprise service delivery requirements.
* Advise Government leadership on emerging technologies, IT modernization initiatives, infrastructure improvements, and technical solutions designed to enhance operational efficiency and mission readiness.
* Ensure enterprise systems and network support activities comply with applicable DoD cybersecurity policies, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), Risk Management Framework (RMF) requirements, and Army enterprise IT standards.
* Coordinate with installation NEC leadership, technical teams, and enterprise service providers to resolve complex technical issues and facilitate continuity of IT services.
* Evaluate technical processes, operational risks, and service delivery challenges, recommending corrective actions and improvements to enhance regional IT performance.

### **Personnel Management and Workforce Leadership:**

* Provide leadership, direction, and supervision to contractor personnel assigned throughout the regional area of responsibility.
* Oversee workforce planning, staff

The **IT Program Manager** leads TISTA's prime contract performance on the Department of Veterans Affairs Supply Chain Management DevSecOps (SCMDSO) Integration task order supporting VA's supply chain and logistics Product Line. The Curriculum Project Manager develops integrated plans, manages schedules and budgets, resolves program issues, and ensures high-quality curriculum products are delivered on time and within scope. Working across matrixed teams, this role applies established program management practices, exercises judgment within defined objectives, and provides clear visibility into progress, dependencies, risks, and decisions throughout the curriculum development lifecycle.
  
  
This opportunity is ideal for an experienced program management professional who thrives in a dynamic environment, brings structure to complex product development initiatives, and enables cross-functional teams to deliver innovative, high-impact learning experiences for educators and students.
  
  
**In This Role You Will:**  
Program Leadership and Delivery
  
  

* Independently manage a portfolio of moderately complex curriculum development programs across digital and print products, ensuring alignment with product strategies, business priorities, and defined delivery goals
* Develop and maintain integrated program plans that coordinate activities across Curriculum, Editorial, Production, Product, Technology, Research, and external partners
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to clarify requirements, priorities, dependencies, resources, and milestones across multiple concurrent workstreams

Operational Excellence and Governance
  
  

* Manage independent contractors, contingent workers, and third-party vendors against defined scopes, deliverables, timelines, budgets, and quality expectations
* Apply established program governance, reporting frameworks, and communication cadences to provide visibility into progress, risks, decisions, and changes
* Identify, assess, escalate, and mitigate risks and issues that could affect quality, budget, scope, or delivery timelines

* Communicates Effectively - Tailors clear, timely communication to different audiences and creates visibility into decisions, risks, and progress
* Drives Results - Maintains focus on commitments, addresses obstacles, and delivers quality outcomes within agreed scope, schedule, and budget

* 5+ years of relevant program or project management experience in education technology, curriculum development, publishing, digital content, or a related field

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Technical Program Manager**

Stimulus Technologies – Broadband Division

**About Us**

Stimulus Technologies is a leader in technology services dedicated to bridging the digital divide in underserved communities. With operations across California, Missouri, Nevada, New Mexico, and Oregon, we deliver high-speed, reliable connectivity that transforms lives and businesses. We are a turnkey technology company providing Managed IT Services, VoIP, Cybersecurity, and high-speed Wireless Internet and fiber through Stimulus Broadband.

**Position Overview**

The Technical Program Manager runs the network and systems programs for Stimulus Broadband outside the fiber build: integration of existing markets onto standard platforms, integration of acquired companies, and wireless network projects. The role owns schedule, cost, scope, risk and project gates for this portfolio and coordinates with the fiber deployment organization where they two depend on each other. The Technical Program Manager reports to the CTO.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Own the portfolio and master schedule for network and systems integration programs.
* Market network integration program: migrate each market onto the target architecture and standard platforms, including cutover planning, subscriber migration and retiring legacy systems.
* Run acquisition integration from diligence through cutover and decommissioning.
* Manage wireless projects (sector augments, backhaul upgrades, site remediation) from scope through delivery, using contractors and field crews.
* Track the NMS/OSS deployment roadmap by market and keep platform, network and operations sequenced.
* Own program budgets and forecasts with finance.
* Run project gates and coordinate release to production with Network Operations.
* Maintain the project's intake queue and prioritization.
* Hold vendors and contractors to scope, schedule, and quality.
* Own the risk register and drive escalations to closure.
* Coordinate dependencies with the fiber build organization.
* Report status to the CTO, CEO, and finance.
* Travel to markets as business needs require.

  

**Success Profile**

* Organized leader with can do attitude and able to work across a wide variety of functions
* Holds vendors and internal teams to dates and scope.
* Systems thinking and technical enough to challenge engineers and contractors.
* Writes status an executive can act on quickly.

  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 8+ years in technical program management on network, systems or infrastructure programs, preferably at an ISP, carrier or MSP.
* Experience running migrations and cutovers on live networks with active subscribers.
* Scheduling, critical path, program controls, forecasting, and change control.
* Stage-gate governance and vendor and contractor management.
* Working knowledge of fixed wireless, IP networking, NMS/OSS/BSS platforms, and fiber access.
* ISP business knowledge: take rate, churn, cost per subscriber and payback.
* Preferred: acquisition integration at an ISP or carrier; NMS/OSS platform deployments; wireless capital programs; hands-on engineering background.
* Must reside in Nevada, California, Oregon, Missouri or New Mexico. Adjacent states may be considered for the right candidate.

  

**Physical Requirements**

* Extended periods working at a computer.
* Regular travel among markets for cutovers, project reviews and contractor oversight.
* Occasional lifting of equipment or materials up to 25 pounds.
* Site visits to data centers, tower sites and active project sites.

  

**Requirements**

* Stimulus Technologies conducts pre-employment and random background checks, along with drug, alcohol, and cannabis testing. Candidates must pass all required screenings.
* A valid driver's license and an acceptable driving record are required.

  

**Alignment with Core Values**

At Stimulus Technologies, our core values define how we work. The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

* **Driven to Grow –** Continuously seeks to develop professionally, stays current with industry practices, and pushes to improve processes and outcomes.
* **See a Need – Fill a Need –** Proactively identifies gaps, obstacles, or opportunities and acts without waiting to be asked.
* **Elevate Others –** Mentors teammates, shares knowledge freely, and actively contributes to a positive and collaborative work environment.
* **Extreme Ownership –** Takes full accountability for results, decisions, and mistakes; does not deflect blame or make excuses.
* **Celebrate Success –** Recognizes contributions of team members, acknowledges milestones, and fosters a culture where wins are shared.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (Infrastructure, Security & Compliance)
jobs.description:
**Senior Technical Project Manager (Infrastructure, Security & Compliance)**
============================================================================

**Location:** Remote, United States

**Experience:** 5–8 years

**About Tessera Labs**
----------------------

Tessera Labs is redefining how enterprises modernize their most complex systems. Backed by Foundation Capital and built by leaders in AI (Artificial Intelligence) and enterprise transformation, Tessera delivers governed, multi-agent AI built specifically for ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) modernization.

Tessera compresses ERP modernization from years to weeks.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Technical Project Manager is the customer-facing voice of Tessera's infrastructure, security, and compliance organization. You help customers understand how Tessera is built, secured, and governed, and you make sure our internal teams deliver what customers need.

The role has two halves. Internally, you run projects across IT (Information Technology), Security, Compliance, Automation, and Infrastructure. Externally, you join business-side project managers on customer calls, explain our platform in plain language, and turn customer requests into clear, resourced work.

You don't need to be an engineer. You do need enough technical understanding to speak credibly with customer architects and security teams, the curiosity to learn fast, and the judgment to know when to bring in an engineer.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Customer Engagement**

* Join customer calls with business-side project managers to explain Tessera's infrastructure, deployment models, security controls, and compliance posture.
* Translate technical topics into clear language for customer executives, IT leaders, security reviewers, and procurement teams.
* Guide customers through security reviews, due diligence questionnaires, and compliance evidence requests, from commercial enterprises to government and other regulated customers.
* Identify when a customer needs deeper detail or engineering work, then secure the right internal experts and resources.
* Build trust as a dependable point of contact who follows up and closes loops.

**Internal Cross-Team Project Management**

* Plan and run projects across IT, Security, Compliance, Automation, and Infrastructure teams.
* Turn customer requirements into scoped work with owners, timelines, and dependencies.
* Track risks, blockers, and decisions, and escalate early when timelines or scope are at risk.
* Keep reusable customer-facing materials current, such as architecture overviews, security summaries, and standard questionnaire answers.

**Pipeline and Status Management**

* Own the pipeline of customer infrastructure, security, and compliance requests from intake to close.
* Provide regular status updates to customers, business-side project managers, and Tessera leadership.
* Report on volume, turnaround time, and recurring customer asks to improve how the team works.
* Use AI tools to speed up planning, documentation, and reporting.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5–8 years of experience in technical project management, technical account management, or customer-facing delivery roles.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to lead customer conversations and present to technical and executive audiences.
* Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform), security concepts, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 (System and Organization Controls 2) or ISO/IEC 27001 (International Organization for Standardization / International Electrotechnical Commission 27001). Fluency is required; hands-on engineering is not.
* A proven record of managing cross-functional projects with many stakeholders and competing priorities.
* Strong curiosity and the ability to learn new technical topics quickly and explain them clearly.
* Highly organized, with a habit of written status updates, clear follow-ups, and ownership through completion.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience supporting customer security reviews, vendor due diligence, or audits at an enterprise SaaS (Software as a Service) or AI company.
* Exposure to government or regulated-industry customers, including frameworks such as FedRAMP (Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program).
* Familiarity with deployment models such as multi-tenant SaaS, single-tenant, customer cloud, and on-premises.
* A certification such as PMP (Project Management Professional) or CompTIA Security+ (Computing Technology Industry Association Security+).
* Background at a system integrator, enterprise SaaS company, or high-growth startup.

Compensation Range: $160K - $200K

jobs.title: Senior Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**Senior Intelligence Analyst**
===============================

TrapWire helps government agencies and the private sector protect people and critical infrastructure by making better use of their reporting, identifying connections, and understanding emerging threats. We are seeking a Senior Intelligence Analyst to produce clear, well-supported intelligence for our customers and to lead the development of the analytical tradecraft behind it.

This role has two core responsibilities. You will combine TrapWire holdings, including suspicious activity reporting, with independent open source research to produce intelligence that answers customer requirements. You will also lead the development of our analytical standards, sourcing practices, and review process so that every product the team releases meets a consistent, defensible bar.

In a small company supporting consequential missions, your work will directly shape our analytical capability and how customers use it.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* **Customers act on your work.** They receive timely, clearly written intelligence that answers their requirements and explains threat patterns using TrapWire data and independent research.
* **Our products meet a written standard.** You have led the team in publishing an analytic style, sourcing, and confidence guide adapted from ICD 203 and ICD 206.
* **Review is routine and useful.** A review checklist is in use on every disseminated product, and peer review measurably catches sourcing and judgment problems before release.
* **Customers get better at analysis.** Customer analysts receive effective quality-control and matching support and use TrapWire analytical features and workflows more capably.
* **Feedback turns into improvements.** Customer input has led to at least one new or improved product line and specific software recommendations to the Product team.

**What You Will Own**
---------------------

### **Intelligence production**

* **Produce recurring and tailored analytical products.** Help customers understand their data, identify relevant connections and threat patterns, and make informed operational decisions.
* **Analyze suspicious activity reporting.** Examine customer reporting for completeness and consistency, evaluate potential matches and relationships, and distinguish meaningful indicators of pre-operational activity from coincidence or insufficient evidence. Research information gaps and state the limits of apparent connections.
* **Plan and conduct open source collection.** Use automated tools, manual research, and social media research to enrich or challenge assessments based on TrapWire holdings. Evaluate and corroborate sources, maintain traceable sourcing, and operate within applicable legal, privacy, civil rights, and civil liberties protections.

### **Analytical Tradecraft**

* **Develop TrapWire analytical standards.** Write and maintain our style, sourcing, confidence, and collection guidance, adapted from ICD 203 and ICD 206 to TrapWire products and customers.
* **Run a rigorous review process.** Build and maintain review criteria, review colleagues' products, and incorporate their review of yours. Give candid, specific feedback that improves the work.
* **Raise the team's skills.** Share effective methods, develop repeatable workflows, and evaluate new analytical and collection tools.

### **Customer and Product Support**

* **Engage customer analysts and stakeholders.** Understand their intelligence requirements, tailor products, brief findings, and advise on analytical workflows.
* **Train customers on TrapWire analytical features.** Provide practical support and analytical training that makes customers more capable users.
* **Shape the product.** Recommend software improvements to the Product team based on customer feedback and your own assessment of analytical needs.

**The Person We Are Looking For**
---------------------------------

* **Cares about the mission.** You want your analysis to help protect people and give customers a clearer understanding of the threats they face.
* **Follows the evidence.** You evaluate sources critically, challenge assumptions, consider alternative explanations, and revise your judgments when the evidence warrants it.
* **Holds a high bar and helps others reach it.** You care about how intelligence is made, not only what it says, and you can explain a standard well enough that colleagues adopt it.
* **Welcomes rigorous review.** You accept constructive criticism, give candid and respectful feedback, and take shared responsibility for the quality of the team's work.
* **Takes initiative and follows through.** You manage competing priorities, deliver reliably without close supervision, and know when to seek input.
* **Communicates clearly.** You listen to customers, understand the decisions they need to make, and explain complex findings in plain language to analysts, operators, and technical colleagues.
* **Stays curious.** You investigate unfamiliar subjects, learn new tools quickly, and share what works.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* **Five or more years of substantive intelligence-analysis experience** supporting government or private-sector intelligence organizations, with relevant education, formal training, or equivalent demonstrated expertise in structured analytic methods.
* **A record of independently producing finished intelligence.** Clear key judgments, supported arguments, a clear line between reporting and assessment, and precise communication of uncertainty, confidence, and implications.
* **Working command of ICD 203 and ICD 206.** You can apply analytic and sourcing standards and adapt them to a commercial product and non-IC customers.

**Company:** Astute Business Solutions

### **About Us**

Astute Business Solutions is a premier Oracle Cloud partner and specialized PeopleSoft, E-Business Suite (EBS), and Banner consulting firm headquartered in Dublin, CA. We empower enterprise clients across North America by architecting, implementing, and optimizing modern IT infrastructure and cloud environments.

### **Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Project Manager** to organize, manage, and plan complex, multi-workstream IT engagements. In this role, you will lead end-to-end client initiatives, including Oracle Cloud migrations (OCI / PaaS and IaaS), managed services transitions, and large-scale ERP patching and modernization roadmaps.

The ideal candidate brings a blend of traditional delivery discipline and modern cloud agility, holding an active **PMP certification** and demonstrating a proven record of managing enterprise Oracle ecosystem projects within a client-facing consulting model.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead cross-functional, interdepartmental project teams to complete assigned deliverables on time, within scope, and under budget.

jobs.title: Data Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

The Data Operations Analyst owns lead and account data quality for a hotel-focused sales organization. You'll make sure every prospect that reaches a sales rep is accurate, deduplicated, enriched, and qualified. You'll lead CRM data audits and cleanup, resolve escalations about missing or misrouted leads, and build the qualification processes and SLAs that give the sales team confidence in every lead they're assigned. The role combines technical depth with business judgment.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Make sure leads and accounts entering the pipeline from all source systems are accurate and deduplicated before they reach sales reps.
* Set and keep refining lead qualification standards, and make sure each lead is routed to the right rep, whether the business assigned it or the rep sourced it.
* Own the health of hotel account data in the CRM: clean up duplicate or broken records and keep account structures sound as they interact with other parts of the business.
* Act as the go-to contact when a rep hits a data problem, such as a missing lead, a bad match, or a data error. Fix the underlying process, not just the single ticket.
* Identify where AI genuinely speeds up data QA, enrichment, or anomaly detection, and hold any AI you deploy to measurable standards, such as false-positive rates.
* Build and document scalable data workflows.

### **Qualifications**

**Required**

* 5-6+ years of experience in data operations or go-to-market (GTM) engineering.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM, including account structuring, deduplication, field mapping, and data cleanup.
* Strong data-quality instincts: you can navigate complex, imperfect data structures, find and fix inconsistencies, and connect business use cases back to data pipelines.
* Experience designing or refining lead qualification criteria and SLAs.
* Demonstrated experience sourcing or evaluating third-party data vendors and enrichment tools.
* Strong SQL skills for validating data, investigating anomalies, and pulling ad hoc analysis.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* Experience using AI tools (for example, Claude Code) to build lightweight internal processes.
* Clear, proactive communication, with comfort partnering directly with sales reps and sales leadership on escalations.
* A process-oriented mindset.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a B2B or marketplace environment.
* Python skills.

### **Key Details**

* Start date: November 17, 2026
* Duration: Approximately 12 months (through November 12, 2027)
* Location: Remote (within the U.S.)
* Work schedule: 40 hours per week, 8 hours per day, 5 days per week
* Pay rate range: $60-$75/hour + benefits
* Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
* Engagement: W-2 Contract

Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

**Job Summary**

Across the healthcare industry nationwide, hospitals and health systems face challenges to today’s approaches to expense management, as revenue growth has not kept pace with expense growth. In response to these unprecedented external challenges, MGB launched Sustain in fall of 2023. Sustain is an ongoing organization-wide program that works to build an infrastructure, culture, and mindset around continuous improvement, working to preserve our four-part mission through focus on resource stewardship. To do this, while also funding needed capital maintenance and improvements to deliver on world-class patient care, research, education, and community health, we must seek out innovative opportunities to optimize the way we work and manage resources across our organization.  
  
The Sustain Analytics team is part of the Business Planning department, which also includes Decision Support and Business Analytics teams. The Business Analyst (Finance), on the Sustain Analytics team is responsible for supporting a broad range of analytic, planning, benchmarking, and other operational support activities for one or more designated members of the Leadership Team (Senior VP’s, Clinical VP’s, Operating VP’s and Executive Directors), across the enterprise, under the guidance of senior team members.
  
  
A critical measure of each Business Analyst’s success will be the extent to which the analytic and planning needs of each person supported are met in a timely, consistent, high quality manner. * Assist in creating deliverables for executive and c-suite level leadership, summarizing performance and related comments from local entities and departments
* + Support ad hoc inquiries and analytics from department leaders
* Support leadership across Business Planning, Digital, and Perioperative Leadership with routine system maintenance and upgrades

**Communication Activities**

* Prepare concise, clear, professional summaries of analyses and plans for review by senior team members and Senior Leadership, as appropriate.
* Present findings to staff and stakeholders, targeting the presentation towards the knowledge level and needs of the audience

jobs.title: AMC KC-46 MFOQA Flight Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Universal Technical Resource Services, Inc. (UTRS) is currently seeking an AMC KC-46 MFOQA Analyst to join our team! At UTRS, we enjoy the benefits of working in a collaborative environment of close-knit team members. As a company, we provide a wide range of leading-edge engineering, management, and digital services to the public and private sectors. We are looking for someone that will support our mission to consistently deliver creative, high-quality, technology-based services to our customers on time and within budget.

  

This position, KC-46 Military Flight Operations Quality Assurance (MFOQA) Flight Data Analyst (FDA), works with the Air Mobility Command (AMC) MFOQA Program Manager to measure and manage operational safety hazards and trends across the KC-46 fleet for MFOQA program enhancement and support. Additionally, the FDA enhances flight safety through the management and analysis of data collected from MFOQA utilizing the Safety Integrated Risk Information System (S-IRIS) and state-of-the-art commercial data visualization software programs. This position is remote.

**What will you be doing?**

  

This position will be a key member of the UTRS Aviation Safety Technology team. Duties include:

* Utilize software to analyze recorded aircraft information/flight data in relation to Triggered Events (TEs) and Routine Operational Measurements (ROMs); verify and validate aircraft specific measurement sets; generate flight operations trends and special studies; and detect hazardous conditions and risks.
* Assist AMC MFOQA Program Manager to support AMC's Aviation Safety Action program (ASAP).
* Advocate MFOQA/ASAP program goals, benefits, and proper uses within AMC, and the AF, including AFSEC's Proactive Aviation Safety.
* Assist analysis team in developing, deploying, and sustaining processes that facilitate the collection, reporting, analysis, quality control, and visualization of MFOQA and ASAP data and transformation into actionable information for identifying, assessing, mitigating, and tracking operational hazards.
* Provide knowledge of Tanker/Airlift operational environments, the missions flown, and the maneuvers performed during those missions.
* Interface regularly with analysis team, AMC staff, AFSEC staff, and units to identify areas of interest; generate analysis products; present emerging trends, hazards, and risks; and disseminate (within and outside AMC/MAF) analysis results and corrective actions.
* Collaborate with the AMC MFOQA Program Manager to identify trends and deviations from standard procedures and parameters; identify corrective actions; coordinate implementation of corrective actions with AMC staff; and evaluate effectiveness of any corrective actions undertaken.
* Assist in the development, evaluation, monitoring, and compliance with MFOQA/ASAP regulations, policies, standards, and procedures.
* Generate informational articles, briefings, case studies, cost benefit analysis, marketing materials, and training materials to stakeholders and designated users throughout the MAF and targeted bases on MFOQA and ASAP safety findings, corrective actions, program plans, goals, objectives, benefits, schedule, and the road ahead.
* Assist AMC MFOQA Program Manager with the development of long-term funding needs and POM submittals.
* Support MFOQA/ASAP-related meetings, including MFOQA Program Management Reviews, meetings with Sister Services, Aircraft Information Working Groups, System Safety Groups, industry safety forums, and presentations to Air Staff, AMC, AFSEC, and program office personnel.
* Participate in working groups and design reviews to ensure that MFOQA requirements are included in any proposed upgrades to flight recorders and other data acquisition systems.

  

**What skills will the ideal candidate have to be successful?**

This position will require the following skillsets and experience:

  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher
* 10 years of flight experience as a tanker or airlift pilot

* Joint, HAF, MAJCOM, or NAF staff experience a plus
* Formal USAF Safety Training a plus
* General knowledge of the Guard and Reserve component of AMC

* Technical requirements
  + Military aviation experience and extensive knowledge of tanker aircraft operational environments, operating characteristics, standards, missions flown, and the maneuvers performed for military tanker aircraft.
  + Knowledge of and experience with aviation safety programs, including MFOQA, ASAP, and LOSA, and operational risk management and processes.
  + Proven ability to collaborate with all echelons, from headquarters staff to squadron operations and maintenance.
* Analytical and database software proficiency desired (Excel, Tableau, etc.)
* S. Citizenship required? Yes
* Security Clearance? Yes (Secret)
* Travel required? Yes (Anticipate travel approximately 1 trip every 3-6 months.)

  

Read about our benefits here: Our Benefits - UTRS | Always, Got Your Back

UTRS is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Raytheon is seeking an experienced and forward‑thinking professional to lead key Supply Chain Cybersecurity and Risk Management processes and initiatives within Supply Chain Strategic Solutions. This cross functional position will be responsible for providing guidance on Cyber DFARS/FARS requirements, CMMC readiness, supply chain cyber incident reporting, and multi‑domain risk management. In addition to managing high‑visibility risk activities, this role plays a critical part in developing organizational capabilities such as advancing standard work, refining training and communication materials, strengthening cross‑functional processes, and helping define long‑term strategies for cybersecurity within the supply chain. The selected candidate will gain hands‑on experience in supplier risk management, cyber regulatory requirements, operational excellence, and cross‑functional communication while helping strengthen Raytheon’s supply chain resilience.

* Lead analysis of part numbers and suppliers at risk of non‑compliance with Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification clauses.

jobs.title: Fraud Intelligence Analyst (New Graduate)
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Dashly is a fraud intelligence startup that uses data across employers, insurers, and contractors to fight fraud in injury claims. We expose fraud networks that cost Americans billions of dollars annually, slow commercial development, and erode trust in blue-collar industries.

Backed by Mosaic GP, Altai Ventures, and Remarkable Ventures, with a $5.8M seed round.

**About the Role**
------------------

Fraud is rarely one person acting alone. Organized claim fraud is often run by networks: groups of associated people acting together through a pattern of related claims over time. The cost falls on carriers, contractors, and the industries that depend on fair claims. The evidence is public but fragmented across dockets, deposition transcripts, claim files, and social media.

Dashly investigates organized fraud enterprises: formal or informal groups of individuals, and the counsel, providers, and associates around them, linked by shared addresses, phone numbers, employers, and narratives. We build cases around the structure of organized fraud: the enterprise, each member's association with it, a pattern of related conduct, how long that conduct continues, and its reach across state lines. Our work gives clients and their counsel evidence for fraud litigation.

As a Fraud Intelligence Analyst, you will design, run, and QA the automated OSINT workflows behind our investigations. You will build and orchestrate agentic AI workflows (LLM agents) for account discovery and attribution, court-filing and deposition extraction, media review, and report drafting. You will integrate third-party OSINT, licensed, and public-records data sources via API, and you will own detection quality (precision, recall, and false-positive rate) across the pipeline.

This role suits a recent graduate in cybercrime, cybersecurity, criminal justice, intelligence, computer science, or a related field who combines a builder's mindset with an investigator's rigor. Prior military or government experience is welcome.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Design and operationalize automated OSINT workflows that take a claim from initial identifiers to a finished report: account discovery, attribution, collection, court-document extraction, and link analysis.
* Build, prompt, and supervise AI agents and LLM-based automation for investigative tasks, with human-in-the-loop verification before any output reaches a client.
* Integrate OSINT, licensed, and public-records data sources through their APIs, and evaluate each new data source on historical cases before production use.
* Measure and improve detection quality: track precision, recall, and false-positive and false-negative rates against analyst-confirmed accounts, and tune workflows accordingly.
* Identify, attribute, and verify claimants' online accounts and records using strong identifiers (address, phone, email, date of birth).
* Review public photos and posts and flag activity that contradicts claimant testimony or statements to the insurer.
* Extract facts from court filings, deposition transcripts, and claim files, and use link analysis to map relationships among claimants, counsel, addresses, phone numbers, and associates, documenting enterprise structure, member associations, and patterns of related conduct across claims.
* Produce clear, evidence-backed investigative reports that clients and their counsel can use in fraud litigation.
* Partner with senior investigators and engineers to refine investigative methods, tooling, and report quality.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Required:** Experience using AI coding agents, terminal coding agents, or CLI-based AI development tools for research, writing, or code, with the judgment to validate their output (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, or open source tools).
* Bachelor's or master's degree (or in progress) in cybercrime, cybersecurity, criminal justice, intelligence, computer science, or a related field.
* 0-2 years of experience in OSINT, investigations, threat intelligence, or a related discipline, including coursework, internships, CTF competitions, or military or government service.
* Working knowledge of OSINT collection and analysis techniques and rigorous source documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience integrating REST APIs and working with structured data (JSON), SQL for querying and analyzing large datasets.
* Familiarity with graph and network analysis for detecting linked actor structures.
* Understanding of detection-performance concepts (precision, recall, false positives).
* Familiarity with court records and legal documents, including dockets, deposition transcripts, and fraud complaints.
* Proficiency in Python or a similar scripting language for data analysis and task automation.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* **Compensation:** The base salary range is $61,000 – $100,000, with flexibility depending on a candidate's background and experience. A company equity plan is also included in our compensation package.
* **Well-being:** 100% medical coverage with dental and vision.
* **Sponsorship:** We welcome candidates on OPT (Optional Practical Training). We do not offer other visa sponsorship.
* **Location:** This role is based on-site 5 days per week in our Chelsea, NY office.
* **Work Expectations:** This role requires a minimum of 50 hours per week.

Market Data Entitlements & Operations Analyst

**About Millennium**  
Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.

Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

**Meet the Team**  
The Market Data team oversees firm-wide market data operations and management within Operations & Middle Office. The team partners closely with Technology, Trading, Operations, Compliance, Procurement, Finance, business stakeholders, and external vendors to support access management, audits, renewals, reporting, and continuous cost-optimization initiatives.

**What You’ll Do**

* Process, provision, modify, transfer, and remove user access to real-time market data services across internal applications and external vendor platforms, in line with established service levels
* Administer Bloomberg Terminal entitlements and related user-access activities, including onboarding, offboarding, account and profile maintenance, permission changes, and issue resolution
* Coordinate access for market data vendors, exchanges, research platforms, pricing services, analytics tools, and data feeds, including platforms such as LSEG/Refinitiv, FactSet, ICE, S&P Global, Morningstar, CME, Nasdaq, and NYSE
* Apply approved entitlement policies, business justifications, licensing terms, and access-control standards consistently, verifying required manager, business, application-owner, and data-licensing approvals before granting or changing access
* Maintain complete, accurate, and auditable records of entitlements, approvals, exchange agreements, user populations, licensing documentation, costs, and vendor account details
* Triage and resolve entitlement incidents, access failures, permission issues, data discrepancies, and vendor service requests, providing clear and timely updates to users and stakeholders
* Perform periodic entitlement reviews and reconciliations to identify inactive users, duplicate services, inappropriate access, unused licenses, and potential non-compliance, and escalate licensing, unauthorized-use, data-sharing, redistribution, derived-data, or access-control concerns to Market Data Management, Compliance, Legal, or other stakeholders
* Support vendor onboarding and offboarding, renewals, usage reporting, invoice validation, cost allocation, and audits, while building reporting and dashboards, improving entitlement workflows through standardization, documentation, and automation, and maintaining process documentation and control evidence

**What You Bring**

* 3–7 years of experience in financial services, preferably in market data, operations, vendor management, access administration, trading support, entitlements, or a related control function
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Information Systems, Economics, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered
* Familiarity with real-time versus delayed market data, financial market data products, vendors, exchanges, licensing terms, data-use controls, and entitlement-management processes
* Experience with Bloomberg Terminal administration or entitlement management; familiarity with Bloomberg user and account workflows is strongly preferred
* Strong attention to detail and a proven ability to manage high-volume, time-sensitive operational work accurately and within defined controls
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to reconcile data, investigate discrepancies, identify root causes, and implement durable solutions
* Proficiency with Excel and operational tracking and reporting tools, and comfort working with ticketing systems, structured workflows, and documented approval processes
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and sound judgment and discretion with sensitive information, with a client-service mindset and a strong sense of ownership and control

**Salary Range**  
Millennium offers a total compensation package which includes a base salary, discretionary performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits. The estimated base salary range for this position is $70,000 to $160,000, which is specific to New York and may change in the future. When finalizing an offer, we take into consideration an individual’s experience level and the qualifications they bring to the role to formulate a competitive total compensation package.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

At AWS, Security is priority zero. As part of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Security team, we are looking for a Technical Program Manager who is passionate about how AWS identifies, evaluates, and resolves security compliance risk, and wants to help build the systems that make it possible. The Risk and Compliance Remediation (RCR) team is moving from a reactive remediation function to a proactive, intelligence driven remediation engine that eliminates systemic security compliance risk at its root, before findings reach auditors, customers, or regulators.  
You will remediate technical security compliance issues across AWS service teams, working with builder teams to understand the technical gap, evaluate solutions, and negotiate an agreed remediation plan and timeline that closes the issue. You will also own the delivery of cross team technical remediation programs, and you will partner with engineering teams on engagements to improve AWS’s remediation tracking system, the source of truth for every issue. You will gather requirements, drive technical tradeoffs, and deliver improvements to that system and the automation built on it, translating compliance requirements and risk advisory guidance into actionable technical work. You bring a solid understanding of the design approaches and technologies in your program area, spot risks, and ask the right technical questions to make sure the right tradeoffs are made for the customer and for the engineers who build and maintain these systems.

* Understand the remediation tracking system's architecture, its upstream and downstream integrations, and data model well enough to spot risks, ask the right technical questions, and make sure dependencies are not broken by changes
* Make and document tradeoffs across time, scope, and cost for both remediation programs and tracking system feature delivery, escalating appropriately when designs are too complex or risky
* Provide operational and execution context for risk acceptance decisions, assessing whether remediation is feasible within a given timeline, its cost and complexity, and the realistic alternatives, as input to the team's risk acceptance recommendation
* Translate compliance requirements and risk advisory guidance from security engineers, Security Industry Specialists, and Audit Program Managers into actionable technical work for service teams and tooling partners
* Define success metrics for your programs and theme reporting for leadership reviews
* Own program communication, including status reports, path to green plans, and contributions to PR/FAQs, narratives, and OP1/OP2 planning

  
A day in the life  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------

This position is located at Departmental Offices,Terrorism and Financial Intelligence - Intelligence Analysis. As an Intelligence Analyst, you will provide intelligence and research support to senior Treasury officials concerning threats to the national security, foreign policy, or economy of the United States.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Clarification from the agency**

U.S. citizens or U.S. Nationals; no prior Federal experience is required.

  

**Duties**
----------

*Pursuant to 50 USC 3024 (v), and with concurrence and consultation with the Director of National Intelligence and the Director of the Office of Personnel Management, this position is being established in the excepted service as an element of the Intelligence Community within the Department of the Treasury.*  
  
The following are the duties of this position at the GS-13. If you are selected at a lower grade level, you will have the opportunity to learn to perform all these duties, and will receive training to help you grow in this position.
  
  

* The incumbent is responsible for performing a broad range of analytical and short-suspense assignments involving economic, financial, and all-source intelligence analysis on the structure and operations of foreign terrorist and illicit finance networks, their vulnerabilities, and the application or impact of Treasury authorities used to target them. Associated duties include; identifying information gaps and intelligence requirements; reconciling occasionally conflicting data sources; collaborating with Intelligence Community counterparts to author finished intelligence products on topics including, but not limited to international banking and international trade sectors as well as foreign terrorist and illicit finance networks; and providing verbal, written, and graphical presentation of results to Treasury, Intelligence Community, U.S. Government interagency, and foreign government audiences. The incumbent assists the Office Director and Deputy Director as well as other OIA management in sharing relevant information and analysis developed by OIA with U.S. regulatory, diplomatic, defense, intelligence, and law enforcement communities, in accordance with applicable policy and security guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Opportunity Overview**

Northramp is seeking an experienced Senior Program Manager to lead a multi-phase Service Desk modernization engagement for a federal agency. The agency is consolidating distributed Level 1 IT support across its divisions into a single, centrally managed Service Desk delivered by a Managed Service Provider (MSP) and run on ServiceNow.

As the face of this effort, you will manage the full lifecycle of the Service Desk modernization and serve as a trusted advisor to key stakeholders and decision-makers across every phase of the engagement. You will lead a team of ITSM, knowledge management, and ServiceNow specialists, manage scope, schedule, risk and quality on a firm-fixed-price task order, and serve as the primary point of contact for agency IT leadership.

This role is part of Northramp’s integrated delivery model, where engineers and advisors work as one team to bring sound judgment, disciplined execution, and deep federal experience to high-stakes modernization programs.

This position is a proposed Key Personnel role and is contingent upon contract award. Selected candidates will be asked to sign a letter of intent and allow Northramp to submit their resume as part of our proposal.

**Location & Work Arrangement**

Hybrid, based in the Washington, DC metro area. On-site presence at client locations in Washington, DC is expected on a cadence aligned to program needs, including stakeholder workshops, governance meetings, and executive briefings. This role is not open to candidates outside the DC region.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead the engagement:** plan and run all phases, from project initiation and the 11-week current-state assessment through optional design, implementation, and post-launch advisory phases.
* **Manage scope, schedule, and risk:** maintain the integrated project plan and work breakdown structure, track milestones and deliverables, and manage risks, issues, and dependencies on a firm-fixed-price basis.
* **Direct the team:** coordinate the Lead ITSM/ITIL Consultant, Knowledge Management SME, ServiceNow Architect, and supporting staff so work moves in the right sequence and meets quality standards.
* **Serve as primary client contact:** run governance meetings and status reporting, and brief agency IT leadership on findings, decisions, and progress.
* **Engage stakeholders across divisions:** schedule and coordinate interviews and workshops, and secure buy-in from divisional teams whose support models are changing.
* **Guide organizational change:** oversee change management and communications so users and IT teams adopt the new service model with minimal disruption.
* **Oversee ServiceNow work:** make sure the operating model, knowledge base, and service catalog designs are built into ServiceNow configuration, testing, and training.
* **Support MSP readiness:** guide development of MSP requirements and transition plans that position the agency to select and oversee its provider.
* **Manage quality and compliance:** confirm deliverables meet agency standards, security requirements, and acceptance criteria.

 **Requirements**

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of program/project management experience.
* 5+ years managing IT service transformation or MSP transition projects.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) or equivalent project management certification.
* Experience managing multi-phase consulting engagements.
* Experience working with federal or financial services institutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Experience leading change management in complex organizations.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Eligible to work in the United States.
* Based in the Washington, DC region.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Moderate to extensive experience implementing or modernizing ServiceNow functionality, especially ITSM in a service desk setting.
* Experience with ServiceNow upgrades, reimplementations, or legacy ITSM migrations.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) or similar tools.
* ServiceNow certification or ITIL 4 Foundation.
* 3+ years of experience working with the Federal Government or federal financial regulatory agencies.
* Experience with FISMA/NIST compliance environments.
* Experience managing engagements for federal financial regulators.

 **Benefits**  

* Employee Bonus Programs
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD&D Insurance
* Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Training and Professional Development
* Remote Work Opportunities
* Wellness Resources

jobs.description:
PotomacWave is looking for a Senior Facilities Project/Program Manager to join our team supporting a Federal client in Washington, DC. The individual supporting this position will provide integrated project management, space and workforce planning, design-requirements coordination, network and telecommunications infrastructure project coordination, and related advisory and assistance services.  
  
This role will support assigned construction, renovation, maintenance, facilities upgrade, infrastructure, and office-move projects. This includes workforce planning, space programming, Directorate design requirements, architecture and engineering, construction, furniture and equipment, secure and nonsecure network and telecommunications services, physical security, records, logistics, and post-occupancy support.  
  
**Responsibilities**:

* Provide a single, integrated management capability for assigned projects and timely, decision-ready information on scope, schedule, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, changes, and performance.
* Coordinate facilities work with secure and nonsecure information technology and telecommunications requirements throughout planning, design, construction, move, testing, and occupancy.
* Serve as the principal point of contact for assigned projects; define objectives, scope, requirements, constraints, assumptions, deliverables, and acceptance criteria; and maintain fit-for-purpose project plans.
* Manage schedules, resources, cost tracking, requirements, changes, risks, issues, stakeholders, communications, quality, records, transition, and closeout.
* Maintain integrated schedules showing dependencies, milestones, decisions, responsible organizations, critical-path and long-lead activities, testing, acceptance, moves, and occupancy; monitor performance and promptly report forecast variances.
* Research root causes; document risks, issues, findings, actions, decisions, and changes; recommend solutions; lead mitigation and recovery planning; and adapt to approved shifts in priorities, requirements, resources, and timelines.
* Coordinate authorized stakeholders and vendors supporting construction, maintenance, furniture, equipment, telephones, networks, printers, audiovisual services, and other project needs. Integrate their activities into the schedule without providing contractual direction.
* Prepare management briefings and maintain complete project artifacts and records. Support completion on schedule, within authorized resources, and in accordance with approved requirements.
* Maintain an accurate, Directorate-validated count of current personnel and a rolling two-year forecast of new employees, vacancies, contractors, and other personnel requiring workspace. Translate validated workforce information into seating, shared space, support-space, and move requirements.
* Work with each Directorate to gather, document, reconcile, and validate functional, technical, operational, adjacency, furniture, equipment, accessibility, information technology, telecommunications, and security-related design requirements. Coordinate reviews, document decisions and changes, and identify conflicts between requirements and available space, schedule, infrastructure, or resources.
* Using Government-approved capacity and mission assumptions, assess the difference between validated SCIF demand and available capacity; support development of Directorate allocation and occupancy options; and document operational, schedule, infrastructure, and workforce impacts. Support authorized Government officials in identifying and evaluating potential satellite SCIF alternatives; developing requirements and comparative analyses; coordinating site assessments and design inputs; and maintaining integrated implementation, readiness, contingency, and move plans.
* Gather and document secure and nonsecure network, telecommunications, printer, audiovisual, cabling, pathway, power, cooling, testing, and service-date requirements. Coordinate these requirements with floor plans, furniture, construction, equipment, moves, security readiness, and occupancy; identify long-lead activities and dependencies; maintain deployment schedules; and coordinate authorized installation, cutover, testing, rollback, contingency, and post-move issue resolution.

**Qualifications**:

* Bachelor’s degree in facilities management, engineering, architecture, construction management, information technology, telecommunications, project management, business administration, or a related field from an accredited institution
* Minimum of ten (10) years of related experience.
* Project management experience required with office moves and facilities upgrades, including IT and telecommunications impacts; experience in a classified environment and with classified IT infrastructure; federal-government experience; skill in scope, requirements, schedules, resources, risks, issues, change, mitigation, briefings, and records; and ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage concurrent priorities.
* Strong leadership, judgment, attention to detail, work ethic, research and root-cause analysis, written and oral communication, interpersonal effectiveness,
* The selection of an individual for this position may be conditioned upon his or her successful completion of a counterintelligence-scope polygraph examination.
* **Must have an active DOE Q or Top-Secret clearance.**

**Desired Qualifications**:

* Technical knowledge of network and telecommunications design
* Understanding of classified and unclassified infrastructure dependencies; SCIF project experience
* Federal facilities or real property experience
* Project Management Professional or comparable certification desired.

  
Salary range $100,000 - $150,000

Equal Opportunity Employer/Race/Sex/Religion/Disability/Veteran Status/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin/Age.

**Summary**
-----------

This position is part of the Organization of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. The incumbent serves as the Joint Staff's senior program analysis officer, Branch Chief, and principal integrator for Commercial Support to Operations (CSO) education, training, doctrine, policy, data, and operational planning.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Career transition (CTAP, ICTAP, RPL)**

Federal employees whose job, agency or department was eliminated and are eligible for priority over other applicants.

### **Veterans**

Veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces or a spouse, widow, widower or parent of a veteran, who may be eligible for derived preference

### **Military spouses**

Military spouses of active duty service members or whose spouse is 100 percent disabled or died on active duty.

### **Clarification from the agency**

All U.S. Citizens

  

**Duties**
----------

As a MANAGEMENT AND PROGRAM ANALYST (CSOD) at the GS-0343-14 some of your typical work assignments may include:

* Coordinates with Geographic Combatant Commands (GCCs), subordinate Joint Force Commands (JFCs), and multinational partners to incorporate CSO into Title 10 exercises, theater engagement strategies, and contingency planning.
* Leads planning and execution support for Phase 0 activities, including CSO intelligence preparation of the operational environment, training, and exercise development.
* Develops Master Scenario Event Lists (MSELs), After Action Reports (AARs), and lessons learned to inform future planning and readiness efforts.
* Coordinates CSO requirements across Service Component staff elements to support development of inputs to GCC and JFC OPLANs and CONPLANs.
* Identifies and quantifies contracted support requirements across all phases of operations, including combat, humanitarian assistance, and disaster relief.
* Provides execution and crisis response support by augmenting CSO cells or joint command organizations during transitions from deliberate planning to crisis action.
* Supports coordination efforts with senior staff and peers across the Services, Combatant Commands, Joint Staff, and OSD.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* Must be a U.S. citizen
* Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service http://www.sss.gov
* Resume and supporting documents (See How To Apply)
* Suitable for Federal employment, determined by a background investigation
* May be required to successfully complete a probationary period
* Work Schedule: Full time
* Overtime: Occasionally
* Tour of Duty: Flexible
* Recruitment Incentives: Not Authorized
* Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA): Exempt
* Financial Disclosure: Employment and Financial Interest disclosure required
* Telework Eligibility: This position is eligible for situational telework

### **Qualifications**

**You may qualify at the GS-14, if you fulfill the following qualifications:**
  
  
One year of specialized experience equivalent to the **GS-13** grade level in the Federal service:

* Performing logistics, acquisition, strategic planning and interagency coordination; Administering and providing guidance with Commercial Support Operations (CSO) doctrine and joint planning processes for contractor support;
* Leading the integration of CSO operational concepts across military operations, training and exercise development;
* Initiating and developing policy and coordinating with Combatant Commands, Services, and the Office of the Secretary of Defense (OSD) to operationalize and synchronize contract support integration and contractor management;
* Presenting authoritative recommendations orally and in writing to advise senior leaders regarding assessments and lead the annual commercial capabilities assessment.

*Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.*

### **Additional information**

**All applicants must meet qualifications and eligibility criteria by the closing date of the announcement.**  
  
**Interagency Career Transition Assistance Programs (****ICTAP eligibility****)****:** This program applies to employees who have been involuntarily separated from a Federal service position within the competitive service or Federal service employees whose positions have been deemed surplus or no longer needed. To receive selection priority for this position, you must: 1) meet ICTAP eligibility criteria; 2) be rated well-qualified for the position; Well qualified is defined as possessing the type and quality of experience that exceeds the positions minimum qualifications. and 3) submit the appropriate documentation to support your ICTAP eligibility.
