Culmen International is hiring a **Sr. Program Analyst (R&D)** to provide support for the **Research Directorate at the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA)** and **will be onsite in** **Springfield, VA.**

The position shall support NGA Research’s mission to be a premier R&D organization with the unique focus of leading GEOINT research. NGA Research is responsible for performing scientific research and transitioning innovative concepts and capabilities to solve NGA, NSG, Allied System for Geospatial Intelligence (ASG), IC, and DoD hard problems. NGA Research requires support staff who can assist in the day-to-day coordination and data management that support these activities.

**TALENT PIPELINE - Qualified applicants will be contacted as soon as funding for this position is secured. - Attentive start date is Mid-December 2026.**

What You’ll Do in Your New Role:

NGA Research requires SETA support that is separate from NGA Financial Management (FM), for R&D program planning, budget building, acquisition support, and financial execution of Research, Development, Test, and Evaluation (RDT&E) and Operations and Maintenance (O&M) funding. This support will aid the PPE team, Technical Offices, and Pods in the programmatic and financial aspects of new and existing programs, projects, and acquisitions.

  

* Employ knowledge of RDT&E budget activity codes and policies concerning two-year funding to assist Research in planning, programming, and budgeting activities.
* Generate custom ad hoc financial reports to provide data for presentations, meetings, briefings, suspenses, and any other requirements needing financial data.
* Coordinate with other national program managers and setup and facilitate technical exchange meetings.
* Draft documentation for transition policy or agreements.
* Advise research scientists on tech transition topics (e.g., project planning for transitions, knowledge of NGA processes, and identification of NGA stakeholders or customers).
* Coordinate with stakeholders in NGA Research and in acquisition program offices.
* Brief and report on program status through documents and presentations.
* Prepare and review team briefings, spreadsheets, and written materials for
* Government review and approval in response to recurring and ad hoc technical and programmatic staff actions.
* Ensure that documents require minimal edits and Government direction.
* Create and execute data collection plans to capture previous, current, and future technology transition information.
* Develop data tracking mechanisms and tools.
* Must have experience with technology / transfer process.
* Must understand how requirements are developed and flow of acquisition process.
* Must have technical background and comfortable writing to the technical capabilities involved with the program.
* Must have communication skills.
* Must be processed oriented.
* Experienced in Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience in Tableau, Jira, and Confluence.

Required Qualifications:

* 15+ years’ experience in working in all areas of program budget management
* Active TS clearance with SCI eligibility
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field (technical) or bachelor's degree that consisted of 36 credit hours in technical curriculum
* Willingness to sit for a CI Poly
* Must have technical background and comfortable writing to the technical capabilities involved with the program.
* Must have NGA or NRO experience

Desired Qualifications:

* Master's degree in a technical field
* Prior or current experience working with a research and development organization or government agency

About the Company:

Culmen International is committed to enhancing international safety and security, strengthening homeland defense, advancing humanitarian missions, and optimizing government operations. With experience in over 150 countries, Culmen supports our clients in accomplishing critical missions in challenging environments.

  

* Exceptional Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance plans (including same or opposite sex domestic partners)
* 401k – Vested immediately and 4% match
* Life insurance and disability paid by the company
* Supplemental Insurance Available
* Opportunities for Training and Continuing Education
* 12 Paid Holidays

To learn more about Culmen International, please visit www.culmen.com

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.title: Pensions Project Manager- 12 Months Fixed Term Contract
jobs.description:
Date live: 04/11/2026

Business Area: HR

Area of Expertise: Change

Contract: Temp/Contractor Payroll (Fixed Term)

Reference Code: JR-0000134955

  

In this role, you will act as a dedicated Project Manager responsible for driving the delivery of a complex pensions transformation programme. You will develop and maintain an integrated delivery plan, coordinate multiple workstreams and provide clear visibility of milestones, dependencies, risks and issues. You will bring structure and accountability to delivery, ensuring decisions are escalated at the right time and the programme remains on track against its objectives.

You will work closely with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, taking ownership of detailed project delivery within an environment that is evolving at pace. You will produce high-quality governance and reporting materials, manage activity and ensure interdependencies are understood and controlled. You will bring sufficient pensions and project management expertise to operate independently.

**To be successful as a Pensions Project Manager- 12 Months Fixed Term Contract, you must have the following essential skills:**

  
  

* Pensions industry knowledge combined with demonstrable project management experience within a pensions environment.
* Experience delivering complex projects or transformation programmes from mobilisation through to implementation.
* Planning and delivery management skills, including milestones, dependencies, risks, issues and RAID management.
* Governance, reporting and senior stakeholder management capabilities.
* Working independently and through ambiguity, turning complex requirements into a clear and executable delivery plan.
  

  

**Some other highly valued skills may include**

* Delivering change within financial services, insurance or another highly regulated environment.
* Experience producing Steering Committee papers, executive reporting and programme governance materials.
* Project management qualification, such as PRINCE2, PMP, APM or an equivalent methodology-based qualification.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills

  
  

Your role will be located from our London office

**Purpose of the role**

Focused on delivering individual projects, ensuring completion within scope, time, and budget with a more immediate focus.

**Accountabilities**

* Scope Management: Manages a single project with specific, defined objectives, deadlines, and deliverables. Their focus is on completing the project on time, within scope, and on budget.
* Strategic Focus: Operates more tactically, focusing on day-to-day management of resources, schedules, and deliverables for their individual project.
* Time Horizon: Works with a shorter, more defined timeframe as projects have a set beginning and end.
* Stakeholder Management: Primarily manages stakeholders related to their specific project, ensuring communication and expectations are clear for the project’s deliverables.
* Risk and Issue Management: Focuses on risks and issues specific to their project and works to mitigate them within the project’s scope.
* Resource Management: Manages resources for their individual project, ensuring that the project team has the necessary skills, tools, and time to complete the work.
* Financial Management: Focuses on managing the budget of their specific project, ensuring it is completed within the financial constraints.
* Metrics: Measures success based on the timely completion of project deliverables within scope, time, and budget.
* Change Management: Manages changes that directly impact their specific project, including scope changes, timelines, or resource allocation adjustments.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the bus

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

**MarTech Program Manager – Transformation & Delivery**

**Location:** London, UK

**Function:** Technology – Salesforce & CRM Centre of Excellence

**About Paysafe**

Paysafe is a global payments platform powering the experience economy, with a strong focus on the iGaming, video gaming, e-commerce, online trading, retail, travel and hospitality sectors.

With 30 years of expertise in payment technology, Paysafe helps businesses and consumers lift every experience through seamless, secure payment solutions, including card payments, digital wallets such as Skrill, eCash solutions like PaysafeCard, and a suite of local payment methods.

With approximately 2,900 employees across 12 countries and annualized transactional volume of $167 billion in 2025, Paysafe connects people and businesses worldwide through innovative digital payment experiences.

**About the role**

We are looking for an experienced **MarTech - Program Manager** to join our Technology organisation and play a pivotal role in delivering Paysafe's marketing technology and digital transformation agenda.

This is not a traditional project management role focused on managing individual projects or tracking milestones. It is a high-impact transformation delivery role, responsible for orchestrating a portfolio of strategic initiatives that will modernise Paysafe's marketing technology landscape, consolidate fragmented platforms and enable more intelligent, scalable and personalised customer engagement.

You will work at the intersection of Marketing, Product, Technology and Operations, leading complex programmes spanning marketing automation, customer and product communications, website modernisation and platform migrations.

A key focus for 2027 will be the consolidation of multiple legacy marketing and communications platforms into a more unified ecosystem, leveraging Salesforce Marketing Cloud Advanced and associated technologies to simplify our architecture, reduce operational costs and improve the customer and merchant experience.

You will be accountable for establishing delivery plans, coordinating internal and external teams, managing dependencies and risks, and ensuring strategic investments deliver tangible commercial and operational outcomes.

*The role is best suited to a proactive, commercially minded programme leader who thrives in complex technology environments, can confidently challenge stakeholders, and brings the structure, urgency and accountability needed to turn ambitious transformation plans into delivered business value.*

**What to expect**

**Lead strategic MarTech transformation**

* Own and coordinate the delivery of Paysafe's 2027 MarTech transformation portfolio, ensuring alignment with business priorities, investment commitments and measurable outcomes.
* Drive the consolidation and migration of fragmented marketing and communications platforms, including B2C & B2C platforms including Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Pardot and legacy product communications technologies.
* Manage delivery initiatives involving Salesforce Marketing Cloud Advanced, customer data platforms, marketing automation, journey orchestration and digital engagement capabilities.
* Coordinate the rationalisation of existing product communications platforms, including GCS, Mandrill/Mailchimp, SendGrid and StrongMail, ensuring appropriate migration, integration and decommissioning plans.
* Support the modernisation of Paysafe's global websites, including localisation, automated translation, AI-enabled customer engagement, continuous optimisation and experimentation.

**Drive end-to-end programme delivery**

* Translate strategic initiatives and investment business cases into executable delivery roadmaps, workstreams, milestones, resource plans and measurable success criteria.
* Manage multiple concurrent initiatives, ensuring clear accountability for scope, budget, timelines, dependencies, risks and delivery outcomes.
* Coordinate cross-functional delivery teams across Marketing, Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, Privacy, Procurement and external technology partners.
* Establish effective programme governance, providing clear executive-level reporting on progress, financial performance, risks, decisions and dependencies.
*

At Argos, we’re a digital-led UK retailer that keeps pushing boundaries to meet every generation with what they want, how and when they want it. As a market leader in general merchandise, serving millions of customers through our website, app, same-day delivery and Click & Collect services, we offer real opportunities to learn, grow and shape your career. With roles spanning Commercial, Buying, Merchandising, Design and Supply Chain, through to Digital, Operations, Customer Experience, Marketing, and People and Transformation, you will work with brilliant colleagues and directly shape how we serve our customers every day. From enabling inspiring choice across our owned brands, including Habitat, Chad Valley and Bush, alongside the world’s biggest brands like Apple, Lego, Xbox and Samsung, to making shopping effortlessly convenient, championing trusted value and accelerating our strategy - Argos is an exciting place to build your future.

Fraud Investigation Manager

Why this role matters

The Fraud Investigation Manager protects Argos and its customers by leading the day-to-day investigation of suspected and confirmed fraud. With the significant majority of Argos fraud arising through ecommerce and digitally enabled customer journeys, the role has a strong focus on online transactions, accounts, payments, promotions, fulfilment and linked activity, while retaining oversight of fraud that crosses stores, contact centres, logistics and Nectar.

Reporting to the Fraud Risk Manager, the role leads two Investigation Specialists and ensures complex fraud cases are prioritised, investigated and documented consistently, objectively and lawfully. It turns data, digital evidence and intelligence into clear investigative outcomes and practical recommendations that reduce loss, protect customers and colleagues, strengthen controls and prevent repeat fraud.

Analyse ecommerce transactions, customer accounts, payment activity, device and channel behaviour, promotions, refunds, fulfilment journeys and linked intelligence to identify patterns, connected cases and emerging fraud methods.

Coordinate investigations that cross Argos Digital, Stores, Contact Centres, Logistics, Payments, Finance, Technology, People, Legal, Loss Prevention and Nectar, establishing clear ownership and timely actions.

Use investigation findings and trend analysis to recommend improvements to ecommerce controls, fraud-detection rules, screening activity, customer journeys and operational processes, balancing fraud prevention with customer experience.

Maintain effective case governance, record keeping and reporting, ensuring investigation activity is timely, proportionate, auditable and compliant with relevant law, data protection and information-sharing requirements.

Share learning from cases and emerging online fraud trends, providing practical guidance that helps Argos and Nectar teams recognise risk, escalate concerns and prevent further loss.

Strong knowledge of fraud investigation in an ecommerce, digital, payments or customer-account environment, including evidence gathering, case management, interviewing and root-cause analysis.

Strong analytical capability, with the ability to interpret transaction, account, payment, device, fulfilment and behavioural data and connect information across systems and customer journeys.

Good working knowledge of relevant criminal and civil law, rules of evidence, data protection and lawful information-sharing in a commercial environment.

People-management skills, with the ability to organise case workloads, set standards, give constructive feedback and develop Investigation Specialists.

Experience of producing clear investigation plans, evidence packs, case reports and recommendations for operational, specialist and senior stakeholders.

Sound judgement and integrity, with the ability to manage sensitive information, assess competing risks, make balanced recommendations and escalate material concerns appropriately.

jobs.title: Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**The team youll be working with:**  
Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst
  
  
UK Security Practice | Birmingham / UK-based with flexible hybrid working | Specialist and team lead
  
  
Role summary
  
  
The Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst leads the delivery of high-quality cyber threat intelligence for clients and the NTT DATA UK Security Practice. The role combines hands-on analysis with day-to-day leadership of threat intelligence analysts, setting priorities, assuring analytical quality, developing team capability and translating intelligence into decisions across security operations, incident response, threat hunting, vulnerability management and risk leadership.
  
  
The postholder operates with substantial autonomy, manages complex assignments, influences technical and non-technical stakeholders, and is accountable for the quality, timeliness, legality and ethical integrity of intelligence outputs.
  
  
**What youll be doing:**  
Team leadership and delivery management
  
  

* Lead, allocate and coordinate the work of a threat intelligence team; set clear objectives, priorities, quality expectations and delivery deadlines.
* Provide technical supervision, peer review and escalation support while enabling analysts to exercise appropriate autonomy and judgement.
* Coach and mentor team members through structured feedback, knowledge sharing, skills development plans and support for professional certification.
* Manage workload, service risks, dependencies and competing client priorities; escalate material issues with clear options and recommendations.
* Establish and monitor delivery standards, analytical tradecraft, source handling, quality assurance and reusable intelligence processes.
* Act as deputy or workstream lead when required, representing the capability in client, operational and leadership forums.

Threat intelligence direction, collection and analysis
  
  

* Define and maintain priority intelligence requirements and collection plans aligned to client assets, business exposure, threat scenarios and decision needs.
* Direct and conduct research across OSINT, commercial and government feeds, technical telemetry, malware reporting, trusted sharing communities, underground sources and other lawful intelligence sources.
* Analyse threat actors, campaigns, malware, infrastructure, indicators of compromise and tactics, techniques and procedures using structured analytical techniques.
* Assess source reliability, information credibility, confidence and intelligence gaps; distinguish verified reporting from analytical judgement.
* Produce strategic, operational and tactical intelligence explaining relevance, likely impact and recommended action rather than simply reproducing threat data.
* Maintain awareness of geopolitical, sector, regulatory and technology developments affecting UK and international clients.

Intelligence production and stakeholder influence
  
  

* Own and assure executive threat briefs, campaign assessments, actor profiles, vulnerability intelligence, sector reports and incident intelligence packages.
* Brief senior leaders, clients, SOC teams, incident responders, detection engineers, vulnerability teams and risk stakeholders using language appropriate to each audience.
* Present defensible conclusions, confidence levels, assumptions, intelligence gaps and recommended actions; respond constructively to challenge and alternative hypotheses.
* Build trusted relationships with internal teams, clients, government bodies, industry groups and intelligence-sharing communities while protecting sensitive sources and information.

Operational integration and capability improvement
  
  

* Integrate intelligence into SIEM, SOAR, TIP, threat hunting, detection engineering, incident response and vulnerability prioritisation workflows.
* Guide the use of MITRE ATT, STIX/TAXII, the intelligence cycle, Diamond Model and suitable analytical techniques.
* Develop and quality-assure correlation rules, watchlists, enrichment logic, automation and playbooks, with controls to limit false positives and unmanaged operational impact.
* Use lessons learned, stakeholder feedback and measurable outcomes to improve collection, analysis, dissemination and intelligence-led decisions.
* Support service development, proposals, client workshops and the evolution of NTT DATA threat intelligence methods and offerings.

**What experience youll bring:**  

* 3-5 years practical experience delivering cyber threat intelligence, including complex assessments and review of other analysts work.
* Demonstrable experience leading, coordinating or technically supervising a team, workstream or intelligence function and managing delivery through others.
* Strong knowledge of the intelligence cycle, structured analytical techniques, collection management, source evaluation, threat actor analysis and intelligence reporting.
* Deep working knowledge of MITRE ATT and platforms such as MISP, ThreatConnect, Anomali or equivalent; practical experience of SIEM, SOAR and security operations integration.
* Ability to analyse malicious infrastructure, IOCs, malware reporting and TTPs, and explain how intelligence should change detection, response, hunting, vulnerability or risk decisions.
* Good understanding of OSINT and dark-web research, including legal, ethical, operational-security and source-protection considerations.

* Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive briefing, client engagement, analytical review and constructive challenge.

In this role, you'll translate business and customer needs into clear, actionable requirements that support seamless onboarding, high-quality data flows, and efficient interactions between employers, payroll and accounting providers, and our delivery partners.

Working closely with Product Managers, UX/UI Designers, Service Designers, Engineers, and Operations teams, you'll map end-to-end customer journeys, identify pain points, and drive continuous improvements that simplify complex pension processes. jobs.title: Customer Deployment Manager
jobs.description:
**About Endra**

Every building is designed twice. The architect shapes what you see. MEP engineers design everything that makes it work: the power, air and water behind every hospital, data centre and home. It's a $150 billion industry still run on manual work and decades-old tools, and it's running out of engineers just as the world needs more buildings than ever.

We're building the platform that changes that. Endra's takes over the repetitive work so engineers can do what they're trained for: judgment and design. Some of the world's most respected engineering firms, including AtkinsRéalis, Ramboll, Buro Happold, Hoare Lea, Tetra Tech, AFRY and Rejlers, already build with us.

Since 2024, we've raised $75 million from Andreessen Horowitz, Notion Capital and Norrsken VC, and grown into a team across Stockholm, Zurich, London, New York and San Francisco. We're early, moving fast and setting out to change how the world's buildings get designed.

We're looking for people who care deeply about their craft, take ownership of complex problems, push us to think bigger, and are driven to create something with lasting impact.

**About the role**

For us, a signed contract is the starting line. The moment a customer signs, Customer Deployment takes over, and our job is to make Endra the way their engineers actually work as soon as possible.

As Customer Deployment Manager, you'll own that journey for some of our most important customers: large engineering consultancies with many offices, hundreds of engineers, and a long list of stakeholders who all need to say yes. You'll be the project lead for each rollout. You set up the structure, drive adoption, clear the roadblocks, and make the value impossible to miss.

You'll work hand in hand with our product specialists who are MEP engineers: they bring the MEP depth, you bring the structure and the commercial lens. Together you'll help engineers who have worked the same way for decades adopt a new one.

**What you'll do**.

* **Own onboarding and rollout.** Lead on-site and remote onboarding with our product specialists so MEP engineers get up and running fast and deliver real results using Endra on their very first project. You own the plan and the milestones, and you keep every stakeholder moving.
* **Work every stakeholder.** Cover everyone from the CEO and heads of discipline to BIM managers, IT and the engineers on the project. Keep them involved at the right moments, and turn early users into champions who train their colleagues.
* **Measure and report the wins.** Agree on success criteria with each customer, track adoption and account health, and act on risk early. Turn the results into clear wins for their leadership and for Endra.
* **Clear the roadblocks.** Spot what's stalling early, whether it's technical, organizational, or a skeptical team. Bring in the right people and see it through.
* **Find the next opportunity.** Uncover new teams, offices and use cases, and support account managers in further growing the customer accounts.
* **Shape the product.** Bring structured insight from the field to product and engineering, so what we build next is what customers need.
* **Build the playbook.** Our deployment function is young. You'll define how Endra rolls out, measures and reports, and set the standard the team scales on.

**Who you are**

* You've run or played a key role in enterprise software rollouts, with 3–5 years of client-facing experience in customer success, implementation or management consulting, ideally in a complex, expert-driven industry.
* You've driven change management before and know that getting a large organization onto new technology is as much about people as about software.
* You're structured and organized, and you stay calm when there are many moving parts.
* You take ownership, and your track record shows it in results delivered and responsibilities that grew.
* You have commercial instinct. You know adoption drives renewal and expansion, and you think about the customer's business case, not only usage numbers.
* You're an excellent communicator, in writing and in the room, and a team player who makes the people around you better.
* You’re comfortable building as you go, improving a playbook rather than just following it.

**How we think and work**

* Less is more: We simplify and ship smaller, fast.
* Build the right things: We listen carefully and build what users actually need.
* Velocity & Quality: We build things that last, but we don’t perfect them forever.
* Trust & Collaboration: Strong opinions, loosely held.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and equity.
* Employee-friendly equity terms.
* Private health insurance.
* Regular team events and off-sites.
* An inspiring, ambitious, and global work environment.

**Ready to move the needle?**

Do you feel this is your opportunity to do your most meaningful work and reshape an entire industry? Let's talk!

**Job Description:**

  

**The Role**

This is a full-time role based in London. As an Operations Senior Analyst, you will be a part of the Sixth Street Global Operations Team and be involved in several facets of operations, including private investment execution, counterparty management, pipeline and other cash management functions, and reporting and investment performance/analysis deliverables. The Operations Team supports Sixth Street’s investing activities across the globe for our private credit/equity, hybrid, and liquid credit funds, business development companies, and separately managed accounts. As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to be an integral part of a growing team in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial work environment.

  

**Core Responsibilities**

* Work as part of a single European Operations team, collectively based across the London and Luxembourg offices, that focuses on deal execution for our European private investing activities
* Work on our deal execution efforts, including:
  + Pipeline management
  + Transaction settlement
  + Transaction and position booking and monitoring
  + Exits and restructurings
  + Risk reporting
  + Foreign exchange hedging
  + Bank account management
  + Coordination with counterparties and external partners
* Partner with investing professionals, internal and external counsel, tax, compliance, and other Sixth Street CORE professionals - ensuring good cross-functional communication and coordination throughout the investing process
* Ensure appropriate cash and/or credit are available for new investments
* Ensure investment cash and settlement controls and protocols are adhered to
* Perform the timely and accurate setup of new investments to the order management, accounting, and reporting systems
* Identify and implement operational efficiencies, including technologies relevant to deal execution
* Work with external service providers to ensure tax structuring and compliance requirements are met
* Assist with the development and production of daily and monthly reporting that is distributed to all levels of Sixth Street
Participate in a wide variety of special projects, both operational and financial  

**What We Value**

* Highly motivated, entrepreneurial, and team-oriented candidates with strong communication, presentation, and Excel skills
* Commercial and Results Orientation
* High Trust and Integrity
Strong combination of organizational and interpersonal/communication skills  

  

**Preferred**

* Candidates would possess a minimum of 5-6 years of experience. Experience should include middle and/or back-office operations at a buy-side organization that invests in private, highly structured transactions – those seen at a private equity or private credit alternative asset management firm or investment bank
* Experience with Advent Geneva and/or Allvue is a plus
* Operations experience within the Real Estate asset class would be beneficial
* Self-starter who requires little direction
* Ability to multi-task and maintain composure in a high-volume environment

We do all this globally and as one unified team of investment and control-side

  

professionals working on behalf of our institutional investors and their beneficiaries around the world.

Company Description

  
  

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**

More about **our mission** and **what we offer**.

  
  

Job Description

  
  

We are looking for a Lead Data Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders. You will partner with our Customer Support organisation to help drive data-driven decisions that improve customer outcomes while managing cost to serve and team capacity.

Customer Support is the largest customer-facing area in Servicing. It is where cost to serve, AI and automation, and the alignment between Operations and Product come together. You will measure whether changes to channels, self-serve flows and AI agents are working for customers, and you will be a trusted analytical voice for CS Operations, CS Product and WFM.

As a Lead Data Analyst, you will own key parts of the customer support metric tree, measure the impact of automation and AI, and run experiments and causal analyses that show what really changed. You will also help make sure the team's metrics are defined once, owned clearly and trusted by everyone who uses them.

This is a great opportunity for an analyst who has a keen understanding of customer problems, strong product thinking and is passionate about creating convincing analyses. You will also be part of the Servicing Analytics community of 86 analysts and a wider community of 150+ analysts at Wise, where you can collaborate on cross-team projects, share knowledge and help improve how analytics works across the company.

This is an IC3 role. .

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING**

* Collaborate with senior stakeholders across Customer Support and effectively communicate your insights into real change for our customers. Join us in working towards our mission.
* Own key areas of the CS metric tree, for example contact rate, first response, resolution, CSAT, repeat contact and cost per contact, and make sure they roll up cleanly into Servicing's Cost and Convenience toplines.
* Support target-setting and tracking with Ops and Product leaders, so the team can see whether targets are being hit, not just set them.
* Measure AI agent, self-serve and deflection impact. Estimate addressable volume, actual deflection and cost saved, and the effect on CSAT, repeat contact and quality.
* Monitor automation quality. Support calibration and drift monitoring on quality scoring so automated decisions stay trustworthy.
* Support capacity planning and forecasting with WFM, including demand forecasts, staffing models, SLA and wait-time trade-offs, and regional and outsourcing mix.
* Make trade-offs explicit. Show the impact on customer outcomes, operational cost and team capacity in every channel and staffing recommendation.
* Build and maintain high-quality data models and pipelines in SQL and dbt, and review analytical work from colleagues to keep the bar high.
  

  
  
  

Qualifications

  
  

* You have experience with SQL and building data pipelines (dbt experience is preferable). You are confident working with complex data models and are able to independently design and implement new models.
* You have strong quantitative skills. Ideally a background in statistics, mathematics, physics, engineering, analytics, computing, or any other scientific areas.
* You have strong communication skills and an ability to translate business insights into persuasive analytical narratives that are simple to understand and that drives customer impact.
* You have an ability to structure business problems with minimal supervision and prioritise problems collaboratively with stakeholders. You take ownership of your own impact on our customers.
* Be proactive. You go beyond just the analysis and get things done.
* You have experience with data visualisation tools (Looker, PowerBI, Tableau etc.) and demonstrate confident storytelling ability with data.

**NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT ESSENTIAL**

* Experience in customer support, customer experience or operations analytics (contact demand, WFM, QA, CSAT, cost to serve)
* Experience applying AI or LLMs to support or analytics workflows.

jobs.description:
### **About The Role**

We are looking for a technically skilled and versatile Senior Technical Business Analyst to join our team. This role is crucial in making regular maintenance & improvements, implementing new solutions and longer-term strategic enhancements to our Business Platform. The ideal candidate will be an expert in business application analysis and development, having worked with a wide range of enterprise-grade software platforms, including Salesforce.

You will work within the Business Platform Team and be responsible for eliciting requirements from various stakeholders and translating them into process maps, specifications, user stories and technical development tasks. This will be a demanding role which will require prioritising the backlog of work against business goals. You will need to influence senior business domain experts with support from colleagues within the Business Platform Team.

  

You will work closely with Business Platform Administrators and Developers to help understand business problems and translate them into viable solutions for the business. You will assist in User Acceptance Testing and release management of those solutions to ensure they are successfully deployed into production.

**Responsibilities**

* Accurately capture business needs ensuring processes are mapped out clearly for wider stakeholders
* Manage various backlog of requirements and needs and help map dependencies and understand competing priorities across the portfolio of work
* Use industry standard business analysis principles and tools to define requirements and processes that align with project goals
* Lead small-to-medium-sized projects in an internal consultancy capacity and supporting larger and more complex projects
* Own and manage stakeholder relationships
* Carry out research, UAT and identifying risks and mitigations
* Document detailed requirements, functional and non-functional, that can be validated with the relevant stakeholders
* Work independently where required
* Be an active part of the Business Platform Team to assist the team's successful delivery
* Encourage and facilitate continuous improvement
* Coach and mentor colleagues and stakeholders to apply the most appropriate agile and lean tools & techniques

### **About You**

**Professional knowledge and experience**

* **Senior-level analytical practice:** Extensive progressive experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Product Owner delivering complex, enterprise-scale initiatives across the end-to-end software development life cycle (SDLC)
* **Requirements engineering:** Extensive experience facilitating requirements discovery workshops, root-cause analyses, and gap assessments; proven ability to translate ambiguous business objectives into structured functional, non-functional, and transition requirements
* **Agile delivery & governance:** Advanced practical knowledge of Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe), with a track record of driving backlog refinement, authoring testable user stories with robust acceptance criteria (Given-When-Then), and managing sprint priorities
* **Business process engineering:** Proven ability to lead business process re-engineering efforts, evaluating current-state (As-Is) operations and defining streamlined, automated future-state (To-Be) processes to improve operational efficiency
* **Quality assurance & UAT leadership:** End-to-end experience leading User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including defining testing strategies, authoring business test scenarios, triaging defect escalations, and securing formal sign-offs from key business stakeholders

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

DXC Technology is committed to building diverse, inclusive teams. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and particularly encourage interest from women, underrepresented groups, and neurodivergent candidates. We offer reasonable adjustments throughout the hiring process and are dedicated to creating a supportive, accessible environment for everyone.

**Hardware Asset Management (HAM) Data Analyst**

**Location: Farnborough (onsite 5 days per week)**

**Due to the nature of the work and the customers we support, the successful candidate must be eligible to meet UK Government and contractual personnel security requirements, including the applicable residency requirements for the role, and have the right to work in the United Kingdom. Some roles may also be subject to nationality requirements where these are necessary to meet UK Government or contractual security obligations.**

We are looking for an experienced Hardware Asset Management (HAM) Data Analyst to take ownership of the quality, accuracy and integrity of hardware asset data across the full asset lifecycle. This is a key role within the IT Asset Management function, providing trusted data to support financial, contractual, operational, security and compliance decisions. You will work across Asset Management, Configuration Management, Procurement, Finance, IT Operations and suppliers to ensure hardware asset information is accurate, reconciled, auditable and continuously improved. This is not simply a data entry role. You will proactively identify data quality issues, reconcile information across multiple systems, investigate discrepancies and drive improvements in the maturity and reliability of the hardware asset estate.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own and maintain the quality and integrity of hardware asset records across ITAM tools, CMDBs and associated systems.
* Perform regular data quality audits and reconciliations, identifying duplicates, missing records, ghost assets, unmanaged assets and data discrepancies.
* Reconcile asset information across ITAM, CMDB, discovery, procurement and financial systems.
* Maintain accurate asset data throughout the full lifecycle, from procurement and deployment through to redeployment and disposal.
* Produce asset reports, dashboards and data quality KPIs covering inventory, lifecycle status, warranties, EOL/EOS, utilisation and compliance.
* Support financial reconciliation between the IT asset register and Finance's fixed asset register, including capitalisation, depreciation and cost information.
* Maintain accurate procurement, vendor, warranty and support contract information.
* Support internal and external audits, providing accurate data, evidence and audit trails.
* Work with operational and technical teams to improve discovery coverage and resolve data discrepancies.
* Develop and maintain data standards, validation rules, naming conventions and governance processes.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement to reduce manual effort and improve data accuracy.
* Provide clear, actionable insight and recommendations to HAM/ITAM leadership and wider stakeholders.

**What you'll bring**

  

* Experience in IT Asset Management, Hardware Asset Management, CMDB or Configuration Management data roles.
* Strong data analysis skills with experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources.
* Experience using ITAM or asset management tools such as ServiceNow ITAM/HAM, Flexera, Snow, Ivanti or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of the hardware asset lifecycle, from procurement through to disposal.
* Experience reconciling data across ITAM, CMDB, discovery, procurement and financial systems.
* Advanced Excel skills and experience with reporting/visualisation tools such as Power BI, SQL or equivalent.
* Experience producing asset reports, dashboards and data quality metrics.
* Excellent attention to detail and a strong focus on data accuracy and integrity.
* Understanding of data governance, data standards, validation and audit requirements.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain data issues and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Desirable**

  

* IAITAM certification such as CHAMP, CSAM or CITAM.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or equivalent.
* Experience with ServiceNow HAM/ITAM and automated discovery tools such as ServiceNow Discovery, Tanium, SCCM, Qualys or Lansweeper.
* Knowledge of ISO 19770 IT Asset Management standards.
* Understanding of financial asset management, including depreciation, capitalisation, book value and TCO.
* Experience supporting audits and compliance activities.
* Knowledge of environmental disposal requirements such as WEEE.
* SQL, PowerShell or scripting experience.
* Experience working in secure, regulated or defence environments.

At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

**About Varda**
---------------

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

* Coordinate SCI nominations, program access requests, and customer-required polygraph scheduling when applicable, and verify eligibility and need-to-know before access is granted.

* Plan ahead by forecasting clearance needs with hiring and program teams, and track metrics on processing status, overdue reporting, training completion, and inspection findings.

jobs.description:
AXS connects fans with the artists and teams they love. Each year we sell millions of tickets to thousands of incredible events – from concerts and festivals to sports and theater – at some of the most iconic venues in the world. Since our founding in 2011, we've consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today.

We're passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we're always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment.

**The Role**

The Ticketing Operations Analyst – Product Operations coordinates cross-departmental product initiatives, ensuring effective stakeholder engagement in User Acceptance Testing and managing issue tracking with product teams under the supervision of the Manager, Ticketing Operations. The role also supports data cleansing efforts and fraud monitoring, collaborates on triage and escalation of product issues, and participates in after-hours on-call rotations as needed.

**What Will You Do?**

* Recruits, coordinates, and holds accountable the business stakeholders required to complete User Acceptance Testing (UAT) on new AXS products and features, working closely with the Product Owner and Project Managers.

* Assists with completing client and promoter requests for OTL sweeps, generating reports on problematic orders for clients, and coordinating the bulk cancellation of orders in violation of ticket limits.
* Participates in an on-call rotation with other department staff to assist with daily bulk refunds for rescheduled events and triaging emergency requests after hours and on weekends.
* Provides general and project-specific assistance as needed to the other Ticketing Operations staff under the supervision of the Manager, Ticketing Operations.

**What Will You Bring?**

* BA/BS Degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, or Marketing major preferred.
* 2-4 years of significant experience in live event ticketing and/or ticketing software administration may be substituted for equivalent education depending on the nature of the work experience.
* Ability to independently manage complex projects
* Familiarity with software testing protocols
* Excel experience required, including a familiarity with data parsing and vlookup functions
* Strong communication skills and the ability gracefully enforce accountability standards
* Ability to juggle multiple pressing priorities and meet aggressive deadlines
* Flexibility in adapting to rules and processes that frequently evolve

Currently, full time employees are eligible for these benefits on the first day of employment.

**What's in it for You?**

* **Extraordinary People** – we're not kidding!
* **Meaningful Mission**– Helping revolutionize an industry and deliver better experiences for fans and clients around the world.
* **Development and Learning** – Opportunities for learning and leveling up through training and education reimbursement.

AXS, a subsidiary of AEG, sells millions of tickets each year for 1600+ premier venues, sports teams, and event organizers across North America, Europe, Asia, Australia and New Zealand. jobs.title: Permanent Contract – Merchandising Project Manager - Export Local Markets & Travel Retail EMEA – CHANEL Europe – January 2027 – M/F/D
jobs.description:
About the Role

  

Join the Export Local Markets & Travel Retail EMEA team as a Merchandising Project Manager on a permanent contract. You will be responsible for shaping and leading the end-to-end merchandising strategy for campaigns across more than 30 Local Markets and Travel Retail EMEA.

  
  

Reporting to the Category, Client Experience & Merchandising Manager, you will work closely with Category, Marketing, Sales, and Forecasting teams to ensure consistent, impactful, and market-relevant campaign deployments. The position is based in Paris. The application period will remain open for 2 weeks until 17 november 2026.

  
  

What impact you can create at Chanel

  

* Oversee the end-to-end merchandising strategy for campaigns, from budget development and forecasting including the delivery of non-catalogued campaign assets and define implementation guidelines to ensure consistent, high-quality execution across all points of sale.
  

  

* Co-develop the permanent assortment strategy with the Product Manager for local markets and EMEA Travel Retail, optimising the offer by point of sale according to its potential, format, available space, channel-specific requirements and business priorities.
  

  

* Define scalable, channel-specific merchandising solutions that address the diverse needs of local markets as well as the specific constraints of the Travel Retail channel.
  

  

* Support markets and partners throughout campaign deployment, ensuring clear communication, brand excellence and consistent implementation across all points of sale.
  

  

* Design and deliver campaign-focused training sessions and workshops, organise and facilitate seminars, and provide operational support to equip market and field teams with the merchandising skills, tools and best practices required to ensure consistent execution.
  

  

You are energised by

  

* The opportunity to shape how campaigns come to life across two complementary and highly diverse distribution environments, by developing strategies tailored to the specificities of Local Markets and Travel Retail EMEA.
  

  

* Becoming a key contributor in designing and deploying campaigns that combine the high standards of the Brand with the agility required to address the needs of each market and channel.
  

  

* Directly strengthening Brand visibility and desirability across the entire point-of-sale network.
  

  

* Playing a central coordination role between cross-functional teams and markets to continuously elevate executional excellence across the network.
  

  

What you will bring

  

* A Master’s degree or Business School background, with 3 to 5 years of experience in merchandising, operational marketing, campaign management, or a related field.
  

  

* Strong strategic thinking and project management skills, with the ability to turn campaign ambition into concrete retail execution.
  

  

* The ability to navigate complex, multicultural, and multi-channel environments, adapting solutions without compromising Brand standards.
  

  

* Fluent in French and English, you are comfortable communicating, engaging stakeholders, and building strong relationships in an international environment.
  

  

* Previous experience with the IWD merchandising software would be appreciated.
  

  

What Chanel can offer you

  

* The opportunity to operate within a uniquely rich and diverse distribution network: more than 30 Local Markets with varying levels of maturity, consumer profiles, and retail environments, alongside the distinctive Travel Retail ecosystem across airports in Europe, Africa, and the Middle East.
  

  

* The chance to shape a high-impact strategy, directly influencing Brand visibility, point-of-sale executional excellence, and commercial performance across both channels.
  

  

* The opportunity to strengthen your business and strategic perspective through the management of merchandising budgets and investment trade-offs across markets with diverse potential, challenges, and constraints.
  

  

* A rewarding management experience, supporting the development and autonomy of an apprentice.
  

  

* Guide markets and partners throughout campaign execution, ensuring clarity, Brand excellence, and consistent implementation across points of sale.
  

  

*At CHANEL, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to CHANEL.*

À propos du poste

  

Vous rejoignez en CDI l’équipe Export Marchés Locaux & Travel Retail EMEA comme Chef(fe) de Projet Merchandising, en charge de la stratégie merchandising des campagnes de bout en bout sur plus de 30 marchés locaux et le Travel Retail.

  
  

Rattaché(e) à la Responsable Category, Expérience Client & Merchandising, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Category, Marketing, Sales et Forecasting afin de garantir des déploiements cohérents, impactants et adaptés aux spécificités de chaque marché et canal. Le poste est basé à Paris. La période de candidature restera ouverte pendant deux semaines, jusqu’au 17 novembre 2026.

  
  
  

L’impact que vous pouvez créer chez CHANEL

  

* Superviser la stratégie merchandising de bout en bout pour les campagnes, depuis l’élaboration des budgets et des prévisions jusqu’à la livraison des supports de campagne hors catalogue, et définir les directives de mise en œuvre afin de garantir une exécution cohérente et de haute qualité sur l’ensemble des points de vente.
  

  

* Co-construire avec le Product Manager la stratégie d’assortiment permanent pour les marchés locau

jobs.title: Compliance Assurance Program Manager
jobs.description:
The global privacy regulatory landscape is not static, and the product and technical landscape at Meta changes multiple times daily to continue to meet and meet the needs of our more than 3.5 billion daily users on our platform. The Compliance Assurance Program Manager (CAPM) works at the center of privacy regulation, legal, business, product, and engineering to put our users' privacy at the center of everything we do.The Exam & Audit (E&A) team, part of Meta's Regulatory Compliance Program (RCP), manages Meta's regulatory examination and audit engagements. E&A connects internal stakeholders with external assessors and regulators. Its work includes delivering external assessor testing on time and at quality, defending the program's position on findings, and driving remediation of identified gaps. As the second line of defense, E&A also gives compliance advice and independent oversight of Meta's privacy safeguards. It challenges their design and effectiveness so that compliance becomes a catalyst for trusted, responsible product growth rather than a constraint.This role sits in the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) domain. TPRM covers the safeguards that govern how third parties (developers, partners, vendors and service providers) access, use and protect Meta user data. The CAPM will be the second-line partner for these safeguards and will lead their readiness for independent assessment.We are looking for an individual contributor who brings audit, risk, and privacy expertise to serve as a trusted second-line advisor and assessment lead for third-party safeguards. jobs.title: Customer Deployment Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
**About Endra**

Every building is designed twice. The architect shapes what you see. MEP engineers design everything that makes it work: the power, air and water behind every hospital, data centre and home. It's a $150 billion industry still run on manual work and decades-old tools, and it's running out of engineers just as the world needs more buildings than ever.

We're building the platform that changes that. Endra's takes over the repetitive work so engineers can do what they're trained for: judgment and design. Some of the world's most respected engineering firms, including AtkinsRéalis, Ramboll, Buro Happold, Hoare Lea, Tetra Tech, AFRY and Rejlers, already build with us.

Since 2024, we've raised $75 million from Andreessen Horowitz, Notion Capital and Norrsken VC, and grown into a team across Stockholm, Zurich, London, New York and San Francisco. We're early, moving fast and setting out to change how the world's buildings get designed.

We're looking for people who care deeply about their craft, take ownership of complex problems, push us to think bigger, and are driven to create something with lasting impact.

**About the role**

For us, a signed contract is the starting line. The moment a customer signs, Customer Deployment takes over, and our job is to make Endra the way their engineers actually work as soon as possible.

As Customer Deployment Manager, you'll own that journey for some of our most important customers: large engineering consultancies with many offices, hundreds of engineers, and a long list of stakeholders who all need to say yes. You'll be the project lead for each rollout. You set up the structure, drive adoption, clear the roadblocks, and make the value impossible to miss.

You'll work hand in hand with our product specialists who are MEP engineers: they bring the MEP depth, you bring the structure and the commercial lens. Together you'll help engineers who have worked the same way for decades adopt a new one.

**What you'll do**.

* **Own onboarding and rollout.** Lead on-site and remote onboarding with our product specialists so MEP engineers get up and running fast and deliver real results using Endra on their very first project. You own the plan and the milestones, and you keep every stakeholder moving.
* **Work every stakeholder.** Cover everyone from the CEO and heads of discipline to BIM managers, IT and the engineers on the project. Keep them involved at the right moments, and turn early users into champions who train their colleagues.
* **Measure and report the wins.** Agree on success criteria with each customer, track adoption and account health, and act on risk early. Turn the results into clear wins for their leadership and for Endra.
* **Clear the roadblocks.** Spot what's stalling early, whether it's technical, organizational, or a skeptical team. Bring in the right people and see it through.
* **Find the next opportunity.** Uncover new teams, offices and use cases, and support account managers in further growing the customer accounts.
* **Shape the product.** Bring structured insight from the field to product and engineering, so what we build next is what customers need.
* **Build the playbook.** Our deployment function is young. You'll define how Endra rolls out, measures and reports, and set the standard the team scales on.

**Who you are**

* You've run or played a key role in enterprise software rollouts, with 3–5 years of client-facing experience in customer success, implementation or management consulting, ideally in a complex, expert-driven industry.
* You've driven change management before and know that getting a large organization onto new technology is as much about people as about software.
* You're structured and organized, and you stay calm when there are many moving parts.
* You take ownership, and your track record shows it in results delivered and responsibilities that grew.
* You have commercial instinct. You know adoption drives renewal and expansion, and you think about the customer's business case, not only usage numbers.
* You're an excellent communicator, in writing and in the room, and a team player who makes the people around you better.
* You’re comfortable building as you go, improving a playbook rather than just following it.

**How we think and work**

* Less is more: We simplify and ship smaller, fast.
* Build the right things: We listen carefully and build what users actually need.
* Velocity & Quality: We build things that last, but we don’t perfect them forever.
* Trust & Collaboration: Strong opinions, loosely held.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and equity.
* Employee-friendly equity terms.
* Private health insurance.
* Regular team events and off-sites.
* An inspiring, ambitious, and global work environment.

**Ready to move the needle?**

Do you feel this is your opportunity to do your most meaningful work and reshape an entire industry? Let's talk!

Compensation Range: $140K - $190K

PMs play a critical role in the team’s success by understanding business priorities, establishing team strategy, ensuring good communication, building a deep understanding of our systems & analytics, bringing structure and clarity to uncertain situations with competing priorities, and driving progress towards deliverables. ----------------------

**Flex recruitment:**  
There are currently three (3) full-time, regular hire Capital Planning and Project Manager I/II (CPPM I/II) vacancies in the Capital Projects Division. Candidates will be considered for the level they meet minimum qualifications.

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager (Infrastructure, Security & Compliance)
new_jobs.description:
**Senior Technical Project Manager (Infrastructure, Security & Compliance)**
============================================================================

**Location:** Remote, United States

**Experience:** 5–8 years

**About Tessera Labs**
----------------------

Tessera Labs is redefining how enterprises modernize their most complex systems. Backed by Foundation Capital and built by leaders in AI (Artificial Intelligence) and enterprise transformation, Tessera delivers governed, multi-agent AI built specifically for ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) modernization.

Tessera compresses ERP modernization from years to weeks.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Technical Project Manager is the customer-facing voice of Tessera's infrastructure, security, and compliance organization. You help customers understand how Tessera is built, secured, and governed, and you make sure our internal teams deliver what customers need.

The role has two halves. Internally, you run projects across IT (Information Technology), Security, Compliance, Automation, and Infrastructure. Externally, you join business-side project managers on customer calls, explain our platform in plain language, and turn customer requests into clear, resourced work.

You don't need to be an engineer. You do need enough technical understanding to speak credibly with customer architects and security teams, the curiosity to learn fast, and the judgment to know when to bring in an engineer.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Customer Engagement**

* Join customer calls with business-side project managers to explain Tessera's infrastructure, deployment models, security controls, and compliance posture.
* Translate technical topics into clear language for customer executives, IT leaders, security reviewers, and procurement teams.
* Guide customers through security reviews, due diligence questionnaires, and compliance evidence requests, from commercial enterprises to government and other regulated customers.
* Identify when a customer needs deeper detail or engineering work, then secure the right internal experts and resources.
* Build trust as a dependable point of contact who follows up and closes loops.

**Internal Cross-Team Project Management**

* Plan and run projects across IT, Security, Compliance, Automation, and Infrastructure teams.
* Turn customer requirements into scoped work with owners, timelines, and dependencies.
* Track risks, blockers, and decisions, and escalate early when timelines or scope are at risk.
* Keep reusable customer-facing materials current, such as architecture overviews, security summaries, and standard questionnaire answers.

**Pipeline and Status Management**

* Own the pipeline of customer infrastructure, security, and compliance requests from intake to close.
* Provide regular status updates to customers, business-side project managers, and Tessera leadership.
* Report on volume, turnaround time, and recurring customer asks to improve how the team works.
* Use AI tools to speed up planning, documentation, and reporting.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5–8 years of experience in technical project management, technical account management, or customer-facing delivery roles.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to lead customer conversations and present to technical and executive audiences.
* Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform), security concepts, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 (System and Organization Controls 2) or ISO/IEC 27001 (International Organization for Standardization / International Electrotechnical Commission 27001). Fluency is required; hands-on engineering is not.
* A proven record of managing cross-functional projects with many stakeholders and competing priorities.
* Strong curiosity and the ability to learn new technical topics quickly and explain them clearly.
* Highly organized, with a habit of written status updates, clear follow-ups, and ownership through completion.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience supporting customer security reviews, vendor due diligence, or audits at an enterprise SaaS (Software as a Service) or AI company.
* Exposure to government or regulated-industry customers, including frameworks such as FedRAMP (Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program).
* Familiarity with deployment models such as multi-tenant SaaS, single-tenant, customer cloud, and on-premises.
* A certification such as PMP (Project Management Professional) or CompTIA Security+ (Computing Technology Industry Association Security+).
* Background at a system integrator, enterprise SaaS company, or high-growth startup.

Compensation Range: $160K - $200K

new_jobs.description:
**Senior Intelligence Analyst**
===============================

TrapWire helps government agencies and the private sector protect people and critical infrastructure by making better use of their reporting, identifying connections, and understanding emerging threats. We are seeking a Senior Intelligence Analyst to produce clear, well-supported intelligence for our customers and to lead the development of the analytical tradecraft behind it.

This role has two core responsibilities. You will combine TrapWire holdings, including suspicious activity reporting, with independent open source research to produce intelligence that answers customer requirements. You will also lead the development of our analytical standards, sourcing practices, and review process so that every product the team releases meets a consistent, defensible bar.

In a small company supporting consequential missions, your work will directly shape our analytical capability and how customers use it.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* **Customers act on your work.** They receive timely, clearly written intelligence that answers their requirements and explains threat patterns using TrapWire data and independent research.
* **Our products meet a written standard.** You have led the team in publishing an analytic style, sourcing, and confidence guide adapted from ICD 203 and ICD 206.
* **Review is routine and useful.** A review checklist is in use on every disseminated product, and peer review measurably catches sourcing and judgment problems before release.
* **Customers get better at analysis.** Customer analysts receive effective quality-control and matching support and use TrapWire analytical features and workflows more capably.
* **Feedback turns into improvements.** Customer input has led to at least one new or improved product line and specific software recommendations to the Product team.

**What You Will Own**
---------------------

### **Intelligence production**

* **Produce recurring and tailored analytical products.** Help customers understand their data, identify relevant connections and threat patterns, and make informed operational decisions.
* **Analyze suspicious activity reporting.** Examine customer reporting for completeness and consistency, evaluate potential matches and relationships, and distinguish meaningful indicators of pre-operational activity from coincidence or insufficient evidence. Research information gaps and state the limits of apparent connections.
* **Plan and conduct open source collection.** Use automated tools, manual research, and social media research to enrich or challenge assessments based on TrapWire holdings. Evaluate and corroborate sources, maintain traceable sourcing, and operate within applicable legal, privacy, civil rights, and civil liberties protections.

### **Analytical Tradecraft**

* **Develop TrapWire analytical standards.** Write and maintain our style, sourcing, confidence, and collection guidance, adapted from ICD 203 and ICD 206 to TrapWire products and customers.
* **Run a rigorous review process.** Build and maintain review criteria, review colleagues' products, and incorporate their review of yours. Give candid, specific feedback that improves the work.
* **Raise the team's skills.** Share effective methods, develop repeatable workflows, and evaluate new analytical and collection tools.

### **Customer and Product Support**

* **Engage customer analysts and stakeholders.** Understand their intelligence requirements, tailor products, brief findings, and advise on analytical workflows.
* **Train customers on TrapWire analytical features.** Provide practical support and analytical training that makes customers more capable users.
* **Shape the product.** Recommend software improvements to the Product team based on customer feedback and your own assessment of analytical needs.

**The Person We Are Looking For**
---------------------------------

* **Cares about the mission.** You want your analysis to help protect people and give customers a clearer understanding of the threats they face.
* **Follows the evidence.** You evaluate sources critically, challenge assumptions, consider alternative explanations, and revise your judgments when the evidence warrants it.
* **Holds a high bar and helps others reach it.** You care about how intelligence is made, not only what it says, and you can explain a standard well enough that colleagues adopt it.
* **Welcomes rigorous review.** You accept constructive criticism, give candid and respectful feedback, and take shared responsibility for the quality of the team's work.
* **Takes initiative and follows through.** You manage competing priorities, deliver reliably without close supervision, and know when to seek input.
* **Communicates clearly.** You listen to customers, understand the decisions they need to make, and explain complex findings in plain language to analysts, operators, and technical colleagues.
* **Stays curious.** You investigate unfamiliar subjects, learn new tools quickly, and share what works.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* **Five or more years of substantive intelligence-analysis experience** supporting government or private-sector intelligence organizations, with relevant education, formal training, or equivalent demonstrated expertise in structured analytic methods.

* **Working command of ICD 203 and ICD 206.** You can apply analytic and sourcing standards and adapt them to a commercial product and non-IC customers.

### **About the Role**

The Data Operations Analyst owns lead and account data quality for a hotel-focused sales organization. You'll make sure every prospect that reaches a sales rep is accurate, deduplicated, enriched, and qualified. * Own the health of hotel account data in the CRM: clean up duplicate or broken records and keep account structures sound as they interact with other parts of the business.

* Experience designing or refining lead qualification criteria and SLAs.
