new_jobs.description:
Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

**Job Summary**

Across the healthcare industry nationwide, hospitals and health systems face challenges to today’s approaches to expense management, as revenue growth has not kept pace with expense growth. In response to these unprecedented external challenges, MGB launched Sustain in fall of 2023. Sustain is an ongoing organization-wide program that works to build an infrastructure, culture, and mindset around continuous improvement, working to preserve our four-part mission through focus on resource stewardship. To do this, while also funding needed capital maintenance and improvements to deliver on world-class patient care, research, education, and community health, we must seek out innovative opportunities to optimize the way we work and manage resources across our organization.  
  
The Sustain Analytics team is part of the Business Planning department, which also includes Decision Support and Business Analytics teams. The Business Analyst (Finance), on the Sustain Analytics team is responsible for supporting a broad range of analytic, planning, benchmarking, and other operational support activities for one or more designated members of the Leadership Team (Senior VP’s, Clinical VP’s, Operating VP’s and Executive Directors), across the enterprise, under the guidance of senior team members.
  
  
A critical measure of each Business Analyst’s success will be the extent to which the analytic and planning needs of each person supported are met in a timely, consistent, high quality manner. This will require close collaboration with staff within the clinical departments, and many other analytic, financial, and planning groups throughout the MGB enterprise, including Sustain Management Office (SMO), Business Planning, Financial Planning, Digital, and local financial, operational, and analytical teams and decision-making bodies at each of the MGB entities. An ability to synthesize, summarize and effectively communicate the analytic and planning work that is performed is key.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; Academic experience focused in finance, financial analytics, data analytics, and/or operations management
* 2+ years of healthcare, financial, or business analysis experience required
* Experience in materials management analytics, clinical supply utilization analytics, surgical capacity, and/or data analytics preferred; relevant internship or co-op experience will be considered
* Experience working in a health system, hospital and/or similar medical center environment preferred.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Surgical Profitability: General**

* Support data analytic needs that inform strategic business decision making on surgical profitability, including surgical cost reduction, clinical supply utilization optimization, OR efficiency, and improved block scheduling, offering direct support for select service lines including Orthopedics and/or Heart and Vascular.
* + Assessing current state surgical profitability for comparable procedures performed in perioperative and procedural areas across the MGB enterprise
* + Identifying potential areas of opportunity through analyzing differences in clinical supply utilization across and within the different entities at MGB, including surgeon and product variation and waste reduction
* + Collaborating with perioperative and procedural teams areas to better understand clinical application and financial opportunity, relative to quality and preference
* + Quantifying financial impact of any recommended changes in practice
* + Assist with financial reporting and analysis by procedure and/or procedure groups to enhance service line growth strategy across the perioperative and procedural areas
* + Utilize industry benchmarks to compare cost, profitability, utilization, and pricing for procedural cases and clinical supplies
* Support the development of consistent executive level reporting, to be used by clinical and administrative leaders within the perioperative and procedural areas, to measure performance and support best practice across the enterprise
* Help catalogue current state analytics across various systems, and support the development of standard analytics and reporting in one single system to meet varied stakeholder needs across the enterprise
* Escalate challenges, discrepancies, roadblocks regarding data and analytics to manager or appropriate data owner

**Surgical Profitability: Information Systems Management**

* Support external system used for surgical capacity and surgical cost/clinical supply utilization reporting:
* + Support administrative maintenance of system through collaborating with appropriate internal and external teams, escalating data or system issues to leadership, and communicating downtime and system updates to end users
* Assist in creating deliverables for executive and c-suite level leadership, summarizing performance and related comments from local entities and departments
* + Support ad hoc inquiries and analytics from department leaders
* Support leadership across Business Planning, Digital, and Perioperative Leadership with routine system maintenance and upgrades

**Communication Activities**

* Prepare concise, clear, professional summaries of analyses and plans for review by senior team members and Senior Leadership, as appropriate.
* Present findings to staff and stakeholders, targeting the presentation towards the knowledge level and needs of the audience

new_jobs.title: AMC KC-46 MFOQA Flight Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Universal Technical Resource Services, Inc. (UTRS) is currently seeking an AMC KC-46 MFOQA Analyst to join our team! At UTRS, we enjoy the benefits of working in a collaborative environment of close-knit team members. As a company, we provide a wide range of leading-edge engineering, management, and digital services to the public and private sectors. We are looking for someone that will support our mission to consistently deliver creative, high-quality, technology-based services to our customers on time and within budget.

  

This position, KC-46 Military Flight Operations Quality Assurance (MFOQA) Flight Data Analyst (FDA), works with the Air Mobility Command (AMC) MFOQA Program Manager to measure and manage operational safety hazards and trends across the KC-46 fleet for MFOQA program enhancement and support. Additionally, the FDA enhances flight safety through the management and analysis of data collected from MFOQA utilizing the Safety Integrated Risk Information System (S-IRIS) and state-of-the-art commercial data visualization software programs. This position is remote.

**What will you be doing?**

  

This position will be a key member of the UTRS Aviation Safety Technology team. Duties include:

* Utilize software to analyze recorded aircraft information/flight data in relation to Triggered Events (TEs) and Routine Operational Measurements (ROMs); verify and validate aircraft specific measurement sets; generate flight operations trends and special studies; and detect hazardous conditions and risks.
* Assist AMC MFOQA Program Manager to support AMC's Aviation Safety Action program (ASAP).
* Advocate MFOQA/ASAP program goals, benefits, and proper uses within AMC, and the AF, including AFSEC's Proactive Aviation Safety.
* Assist analysis team in developing, deploying, and sustaining processes that facilitate the collection, reporting, analysis, quality control, and visualization of MFOQA and ASAP data and transformation into actionable information for identifying, assessing, mitigating, and tracking operational hazards.
* Provide knowledge of Tanker/Airlift operational environments, the missions flown, and the maneuvers performed during those missions.
* Interface regularly with analysis team, AMC staff, AFSEC staff, and units to identify areas of interest; generate analysis products; present emerging trends, hazards, and risks; and disseminate (within and outside AMC/MAF) analysis results and corrective actions.
* Collaborate with the AMC MFOQA Program Manager to identify trends and deviations from standard procedures and parameters; identify corrective actions; coordinate implementation of corrective actions with AMC staff; and evaluate effectiveness of any corrective actions undertaken.
* Assist in the development, evaluation, monitoring, and compliance with MFOQA/ASAP regulations, policies, standards, and procedures.
* Generate informational articles, briefings, case studies, cost benefit analysis, marketing materials, and training materials to stakeholders and designated users throughout the MAF and targeted bases on MFOQA and ASAP safety findings, corrective actions, program plans, goals, objectives, benefits, schedule, and the road ahead.
* Assist AMC MFOQA Program Manager with the development of long-term funding needs and POM submittals.
* Support MFOQA/ASAP-related meetings, including MFOQA Program Management Reviews, meetings with Sister Services, Aircraft Information Working Groups, System Safety Groups, industry safety forums, and presentations to Air Staff, AMC, AFSEC, and program office personnel.
* Participate in working groups and design reviews to ensure that MFOQA requirements are included in any proposed upgrades to flight recorders and other data acquisition systems.

  

**What skills will the ideal candidate have to be successful?**

This position will require the following skillsets and experience:

  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher
* 10 years of flight experience as a tanker or airlift pilot

* Joint, HAF, MAJCOM, or NAF staff experience a plus
* Formal USAF Safety Training a plus
* General knowledge of the Guard and Reserve component of AMC

* Technical requirements
  + Military aviation experience and extensive knowledge of tanker aircraft operational environments, operating characteristics, standards, missions flown, and the maneuvers performed for military tanker aircraft.
  + Knowledge of and experience with aviation safety programs, including MFOQA, ASAP, and LOSA, and operational risk management and processes.
  + Proven ability to collaborate with all echelons, from headquarters staff to squadron operations and maintenance.
* Analytical and database software proficiency desired (Excel, Tableau, etc.)
* S. Citizenship required? Yes
* Security Clearance? Yes (Secret)
* Travel required? Yes (Anticipate travel approximately 1 trip every 3-6 months.)

  

Read about our benefits here: Our Benefits - UTRS | Always, Got Your Back

UTRS is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. UTRS is a drug-free workplace with pre-employment drug testing and background verifications.

As part of our applicant review and screening process, UTRS uses VeraHire AI, an artificial intelligence-supported platform to assist with reviewing application materials and evaluating job-related qualifications against criteria established by UTRS.

Apple’s Partner Operations team is seeking an experienced, highly collaborative, and technically astute Program Manager to lead platform capability expansion across our Apple services partnerships.
  
  
Description
  
  
In this role, you will bridge business strategy, technical integration, and partner execution. You will guide global partners—spanning telecommunications carriers, subscription video on demand (SVOD) providers, and retail integrators—through the onboarding lifecycle, ensuring they can seamlessly adopt new platform capabilities. You will operate comfortably in the gray, translate complex commerce and linking architectures into actionable operational workflows, and drive alignment across Business Development, Engineering, Product, QA, Marketing, Legal, and more. You will also continue to refine parter onboarding and management processes and tools, utilizing innovative approaches - knowing when to use technical tools such as AI while understanding the necessity for face to face collaboration.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* 8+ years of technical program or operations management experience driving complex, partner-facing integrations, digital customer journeys, and back-end platform capabilities.
* Deep familiarity with subscription lifecycle mechanics, recurring billing, and API-driven partner integrations
* Proven track record in end-to-end partner onboarding & operational readiness, from defining intake processes and writing operational requirements to coordinating production verification testing (PVT/UAT).
* Strong cross-functional orchestration skills, with the demonstrated ability to lead workstreams across Engineering, Product, Business Development, Commerce/Billing, Legal/Privacy, and Regional Operations teams globally.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving aptitude, with experience troubleshooting back-end event triggers, signaling mechanisms, and data-flow discrepancies across multi-party ecosystems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of presenting technical concepts clearly to executive leadership, authoring partner-facing integration guides, and managing multi-stakeholder operational reviews.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* BA/BS degree required; technical, engineering, or business operations background preferred.

new_jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

Dashly is a fraud intelligence startup that uses data across employers, insurers, and contractors to fight fraud in injury claims. We expose fraud networks that cost Americans billions of dollars annually, slow commercial development, and erode trust in blue-collar industries.

Backed by Mosaic GP, Altai Ventures, and Remarkable Ventures, with a $5.8M seed round.

**About the Role**
------------------

Fraud is rarely one person acting alone. Organized claim fraud is often run by networks: groups of associated people acting together through a pattern of related claims over time. The cost falls on carriers, contractors, and the industries that depend on fair claims. The evidence is public but fragmented across dockets, deposition transcripts, claim files, and social media.

Dashly investigates organized fraud enterprises: formal or informal groups of individuals, and the counsel, providers, and associates around them, linked by shared addresses, phone numbers, employers, and narratives. We build cases around the structure of organized fraud: the enterprise, each member's association with it, a pattern of related conduct, how long that conduct continues, and its reach across state lines. Our work gives clients and their counsel evidence for fraud litigation.

As a Fraud Intelligence Analyst, you will design, run, and QA the automated OSINT workflows behind our investigations. You will build and orchestrate agentic AI workflows (LLM agents) for account discovery and attribution, court-filing and deposition extraction, media review, and report drafting. You will integrate third-party OSINT, licensed, and public-records data sources via API, and you will own detection quality (precision, recall, and false-positive rate) across the pipeline.

This role suits a recent graduate in cybercrime, cybersecurity, criminal justice, intelligence, computer science, or a related field who combines a builder's mindset with an investigator's rigor. Prior military or government experience is welcome.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Design and operationalize automated OSINT workflows that take a claim from initial identifiers to a finished report: account discovery, attribution, collection, court-document extraction, and link analysis.
* Build, prompt, and supervise AI agents and LLM-based automation for investigative tasks, with human-in-the-loop verification before any output reaches a client.
* Integrate OSINT, licensed, and public-records data sources through their APIs, and evaluate each new data source on historical cases before production use.
* Measure and improve detection quality: track precision, recall, and false-positive and false-negative rates against analyst-confirmed accounts, and tune workflows accordingly.
* Identify, attribute, and verify claimants' online accounts and records using strong identifiers (address, phone, email, date of birth).
* Review public photos and posts and flag activity that contradicts claimant testimony or statements to the insurer.
* Extract facts from court filings, deposition transcripts, and claim files, and use link analysis to map relationships among claimants, counsel, addresses, phone numbers, and associates, documenting enterprise structure, member associations, and patterns of related conduct across claims.
* Produce clear, evidence-backed investigative reports that clients and their counsel can use in fraud litigation.
* Partner with senior investigators and engineers to refine investigative methods, tooling, and report quality.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Required:** Experience using AI coding agents, terminal coding agents, or CLI-based AI development tools for research, writing, or code, with the judgment to validate their output (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, or open source tools).
* Bachelor's or master's degree (or in progress) in cybercrime, cybersecurity, criminal justice, intelligence, computer science, or a related field.
* 0-2 years of experience in OSINT, investigations, threat intelligence, or a related discipline, including coursework, internships, CTF competitions, or military or government service.
* Working knowledge of OSINT collection and analysis techniques and rigorous source documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience integrating REST APIs and working with structured data (JSON), SQL for querying and analyzing large datasets.
* Familiarity with graph and network analysis for detecting linked actor structures.
* Understanding of detection-performance concepts (precision, recall, false positives).
* Familiarity with court records and legal documents, including dockets, deposition transcripts, and fraud complaints.
* Proficiency in Python or a similar scripting language for data analysis and task automation.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

* **Compensation:** The base salary range is $61,000 – $100,000, with flexibility depending on a candidate's background and experience. A company equity plan is also included in our compensation package.
* **Well-being:** 100% medical coverage with dental and vision.
* **Sponsorship:** We welcome candidates on OPT (Optional Practical Training). We do not offer other visa sponsorship.
* **Location:** This role is based on-site 5 days per week in our Chelsea, NY office.
* **Work Expectations:** This role requires a minimum of 50 hours per week.

new_jobs.title: Market Data Entitlements & Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Market Data Entitlements & Operations Analyst

**About Millennium**  
Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.

Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

**Meet the Team**  
The Market Data team oversees firm-wide market data operations and management within Operations & Middle Office. The team partners closely with Technology, Trading, Operations, Compliance, Procurement, Finance, business stakeholders, and external vendors to support access management, audits, renewals, reporting, and continuous cost-optimization initiatives.

**What You’ll Do**

* Process, provision, modify, transfer, and remove user access to real-time market data services across internal applications and external vendor platforms, in line with established service levels
* Administer Bloomberg Terminal entitlements and related user-access activities, including onboarding, offboarding, account and profile maintenance, permission changes, and issue resolution
* Coordinate access for market data vendors, exchanges, research platforms, pricing services, analytics tools, and data feeds, including platforms such as LSEG/Refinitiv, FactSet, ICE, S&P Global, Morningstar, CME, Nasdaq, and NYSE
* Apply approved entitlement policies, business justifications, licensing terms, and access-control standards consistently, verifying required manager, business, application-owner, and data-licensing approvals before granting or changing access
* Maintain complete, accurate, and auditable records of entitlements, approvals, exchange agreements, user populations, licensing documentation, costs, and vendor account details
* Triage and resolve entitlement incidents, access failures, permission issues, data discrepancies, and vendor service requests, providing clear and timely updates to users and stakeholders
* Perform periodic entitlement reviews and reconciliations to identify inactive users, duplicate services, inappropriate access, unused licenses, and potential non-compliance, and escalate licensing, unauthorized-use, data-sharing, redistribution, derived-data, or access-control concerns to Market Data Management, Compliance, Legal, or other stakeholders
* Support vendor onboarding and offboarding, renewals, usage reporting, invoice validation, cost allocation, and audits, while building reporting and dashboards, improving entitlement workflows through standardization, documentation, and automation, and maintaining process documentation and control evidence

**What You Bring**

* 3–7 years of experience in financial services, preferably in market data, operations, vendor management, access administration, trading support, entitlements, or a related control function
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Information Systems, Economics, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered
* Familiarity with real-time versus delayed market data, financial market data products, vendors, exchanges, licensing terms, data-use controls, and entitlement-management processes
* Experience with Bloomberg Terminal administration or entitlement management; familiarity with Bloomberg user and account workflows is strongly preferred
* Strong attention to detail and a proven ability to manage high-volume, time-sensitive operational work accurately and within defined controls
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to reconcile data, investigate discrepancies, identify root causes, and implement durable solutions
* Proficiency with Excel and operational tracking and reporting tools, and comfort working with ticketing systems, structured workflows, and documented approval processes
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and sound judgment and discretion with sensitive information, with a client-service mindset and a strong sense of ownership and control

**Salary Range**  
Millennium offers a total compensation package which includes a base salary, discretionary performance bonus, and comprehensive benefits. The estimated base salary range for this position is $70,000 to $160,000, which is specific to New York and may change in the future. When finalizing an offer, we take into consideration an individual’s experience level and the qualifications they bring to the role to formulate a competitive total compensation package.

new_jobs.description:
Under the direction of the HR Operations Manager, the HR Operations Analyst is responsible for supporting and optimizing the Legal Aid Society’s Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS) to support HR functions and organizational objectives.

  

This role supports the accuracy, efficiency, and effectiveness of HR operations and serves as a key partner to Finance for workforce data, analytics, reconciliations, and recurring and ad hoc reporting. The position contributes to data-driven decision-making and supports the overall mission of the firm through effective data management, cross-functional reporting, and system improvements.

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Data Analysis, Finance Partnership & Visualization**

* Writes and maintains recurring and ad hoc HR and workforce reports to answer business questions, support operational procedures, and support Finance reporting needs.
* Designs, builds, and maintains data visualization and distribution tools, providing timely access to essential personnel information to stakeholders.
* Analyzes workforce data to identify trends, variances, data quality issues, and compliance considerations, and communicates findings to appropriate stakeholders.
* Recommends new metrics, reporting approaches, and process improvements to support organizational objectives and data-driven decision-making.

**Data Entry & Transaction Processing**

* Supports HR teams with routine data entry and quality assurance.
* Reviews and processes various staffing transactions throughout the employee lifecycle.
* Supports systems components for onboarding procedures for new employees.
* Maintains knowledge of HR policies and procedures and applies knowledge to workflows.
* Applies a critical lens to data processing, escalates data errors and systems issues as needed.

**Data Quality Maintenance**

* Supports routine compliance and data quality assurance procedures across a variety of topics as directed.
* Conducts data analysis and audits to identify inconsistencies, inaccuracies, and gaps in data.
* Performs data entry and correction of issues uncovered.
* Offers training and support to HR staff and other HRIS and Dashboard end-users.
  

**Professional Development and other duties as assigned**

* Participates in continuous professional development as directed.
* Continuously learns about forms of bias in the workplace and demonstrates affirmative behaviors that support an inclusive work environment.
* Continuously learns about relevant employment law changes.
* Continuously learns about data privacy and security best practices.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of work experience or the equivalent of 6+ years of post-secondary education and relevant work experience.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and data analysis fundamentals.
* Proficiency with data visualization tools (e.g., Microsoft Power BI, Tableau).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* 2+ years of experience in Human Resources, Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field is strongly preferred.
  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

**Position Based Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel fundamentals.
* Proficiency with relevant mathematics including statistics, arithmetic, ratios, percentages, etc.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., PHR, SPHR) are a plus.
* Proficiency with HRIS software (e.g., ADP, Workday, BambooHR).
* Ability to reconcile and validate data across HR, payroll, and financial reporting sources.
* Ability to translate workforce data into clear, accurate reporting and analysis for HR, Finance, and leadership stakeholders.

**Organizational Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Commitment to Legal Aid Society’s mission to secure equal justice before the law for all New Yorkers.
* Interpersonal and communication skills that enable healthy and productive working relationships
* Ability to perform duties with the highest regard for confidentiality, integrity, and respect
* Commitment to Legal Aid Society’s mission and values
  

**Physical, environment, travel, and other duties required:**

* Requires occasional or frequent physical movement to perform essential job functions which may include, bending, reaching, pulling, pushing, standing or walking for long periods of time, accessing small spaces

**ABOUT Resources Legacy Fund (RLF):**

Resources Legacy Fund builds the architecture behind lasting environmental progress. From climate resilience to land and water conservation to community well-being, we help visionary ideas take shape—offering the steady support and strategic know-how to turn complex challenges into collective victories.

We deliver transformative outcomes for our planet and its people through trusted partnerships and creative campaigns. Rooted in California and expanding across Western North America and beyond, we have a 25-year track record of supporting initiatives at every scale. We also host fiscally sponsored projects that reach across the globe, reinforcing the efforts of change makers worldwide.

Addressing three interconnected crises — climate change, biodiversity loss, and environmental injustice — requires creativity, collaboration, and fast reflexes. With deep operational expertise and the confidence of donors and partners, we enable lasting solutions to rise.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

RLF’s Hawai‘i program supports programs, policy change, and increased public funding outcomes for clean energy, climate resilience, nearshore marine conservation, and reforestation across Hawai‘i. Our program engages in coalition-building, policy development, advocacy, capacity-building, and grantmaking. We work at a statewide scale and partner with state and county agencies, nonprofit conservation and community organizations, and landowners, and we house coalitions that work collaboratively to advance conservation, climate, and community priorities.

We seek a highly organized, collaborative, and proactive Program Manager to provide programmatic support across RLF’s Hawai‘i initiatives. Program Manager duties span a range of activities and include supporting coalitions and partnerships, facilitating meetings, planning events, managing projects and timelines, contributing to strategy development, creating materials, and overseeing grants and contracts.

This position is full-time, exempt, and reports to the Hawai’i Director. The position is based in Hawai‘i and requires periodic travel throughout the state, ranging from occasional to several trips per month depending on business needs, as well as limited domestic travel as needed to fulfill job duties.

* Organize and, where appropriate, facilitate virtual meetings (internal or external) or in-person convenings. Work with staff and partners to research, prepare, and assemble materials for meetings. Ensure meetings have clear agendas, timelines, and outcomes and circulate necessary materials in advance of meetings.
* Convene staff and consultants to track progress and address program issues. Maintain regular communication with consultants and contractors to monitor timelines, identify challenges, and facilitate follow-through on agreed-upon activities.
* Assist in creating materials for presentations (including reports, maps, tables, graphs, database reports, and PowerPoint presentations) to the Board, partners, and funders.
* Coordinate with staff to develop internal and external written program materials (e.g., one-pagers, presentations, program summaries, or reports, etc.).
* Support program staff with strategic planning and program development and implementation.
* Maintain documentation systems, including shared files, contact lists, project trackers, and other program records.

**Program Management**

* Help manage a portfolio of contracts and grants, including coordinating with contractors and grantees to track timelines, deliverables, and reporting requirements, and coordinate with other staff in managing program budgets.
* Support, participate in, and/or staff (consultation, facilitation, convening, etc.) policy coalitions and other collaborative efforts in climate policy, ‘āina stewardship, and public funding.
* Assist in refining strategies, designing contracts and grants, conducting due diligence, and working with potential grantees and contractors to develop proposals and scopes of work.
* Synthesize reports and deliverables and work with staff to develop grant proposals and reports for funders that document project and program activities, progress, outcomes, and impacts achieved.
* Review and provide feedback on funder and grantee proposals managed by colleagues.
* Represent RLF’s Hawai‘i team at in-person convenings as needed to fulfill duties.

* Remain current on emerging issues and trends in climate and conservation.
* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

At AWS, Security is priority zero. As part of the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Security team, we are looking for a Technical Program Manager who is passionate about how AWS identifies, evaluates, and resolves security compliance risk, and wants to help build the systems that make it possible. The Risk and Compliance Remediation (RCR) team is moving from a reactive remediation function to a proactive, intelligence driven remediation engine that eliminates systemic security compliance risk at its root, before findings reach auditors, customers, or regulators.  
You will remediate technical security compliance issues across AWS service teams, working with builder teams to understand the technical gap, evaluate solutions, and negotiate an agreed remediation plan and timeline that closes the issue. You will also own the delivery of cross team technical remediation programs, and you will partner with engineering teams on engagements to improve AWS’s remediation tracking system, the source of truth for every issue. * Provide operational and execution context for risk acceptance decisions, assessing whether remediation is feasible within a given timeline, its cost and complexity, and the realistic alternatives, as input to the team's risk acceptance recommendation
* Translate compliance requirements and risk advisory guidance from security engineers, Security Industry Specialists, and Audit Program Managers into actionable technical work for service teams and tooling partners

The global privacy regulatory landscape is not static, and the product and technical landscape at Meta changes multiple times daily to continue to meet and meet the needs of our more than 3.5 billion daily users on our platform. E&A connects internal stakeholders with external assessors and regulators. Its work includes delivering external assessor testing on time and at quality, defending the program's position on findings, and driving remediation of identified gaps. The Project Manager will work collaboratively with Government stakeholders to ensure project activities align with USAidam mission objectives, schedules, performance requirements, and applicable Federal cybersecurity requirements. * Monitor project performance and provide weekly, monthly, and ad hoc status reporting to Government stakeholders.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

We're looking for a Business Analyst to help shape and improve the experience of employers and third-party providers across the UK's workplace pension ecosystem. In this role, you'll translate business and customer needs into clear, actionable requirements that support seamless onboarding, high-quality data flows, and efficient interactions between employers, payroll and accounting providers, and our delivery partners.

Working closely with Product Managers, UX/UI Designers, Service Designers, Engineers, and Operations teams, you'll map end-to-end customer journeys, identify pain points, and drive continuous improvements that simplify complex pension processes. * Proven experience working as a Business Analyst within a within a regulated environment, ideally within pensions, financial services, or a comparable sector.
* Strong experience in requirements gathering, stakeholder engagement, process mapping, and user story creation.
* Ability to apply a wide range of business analysis techniques, including requirements elicitation, process modelling, and impact assessment.

new_jobs.title: Customer Deployment Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Endra**

Every building is designed twice. The architect shapes what you see. MEP engineers design everything that makes it work: the power, air and water behind every hospital, data centre and home. It's a $150 billion industry still run on manual work and decades-old tools, and it's running out of engineers just as the world needs more buildings than ever.

We're building the platform that changes that. Endra's takes over the repetitive work so engineers can do what they're trained for: judgment and design. Some of the world's most respected engineering firms, including AtkinsRéalis, Ramboll, Buro Happold, Hoare Lea, Tetra Tech, AFRY and Rejlers, already build with us.

Since 2024, we've raised $75 million from Andreessen Horowitz, Notion Capital and Norrsken VC, and grown into a team across Stockholm, Zurich, London, New York and San Francisco. We're early, moving fast and setting out to change how the world's buildings get designed.

We're looking for people who care deeply about their craft, take ownership of complex problems, push us to think bigger, and are driven to create something with lasting impact.

**About the role**

For us, a signed contract is the starting line. The moment a customer signs, Customer Deployment takes over, and our job is to make Endra the way their engineers actually work as soon as possible.

As Customer Deployment Manager, you'll own that journey for some of our most important customers: large engineering consultancies with many offices, hundreds of engineers, and a long list of stakeholders who all need to say yes. You'll be the project lead for each rollout. You set up the structure, drive adoption, clear the roadblocks, and make the value impossible to miss.

You'll work hand in hand with our product specialists who are MEP engineers: they bring the MEP depth, you bring the structure and the commercial lens. Together you'll help engineers who have worked the same way for decades adopt a new one.

**What you'll do**.

* **Own onboarding and rollout.** Lead on-site and remote onboarding with our product specialists so MEP engineers get up and running fast and deliver real results using Endra on their very first project. You own the plan and the milestones, and you keep every stakeholder moving.
* **Work every stakeholder.** Cover everyone from the CEO and heads of discipline to BIM managers, IT and the engineers on the project. Keep them involved at the right moments, and turn early users into champions who train their colleagues.
* **Measure and report the wins.** Agree on success criteria with each customer, track adoption and account health, and act on risk early. Turn the results into clear wins for their leadership and for Endra.
* **Clear the roadblocks.** Spot what's stalling early, whether it's technical, organizational, or a skeptical team. Bring in the right people and see it through.
* **Find the next opportunity.** Uncover new teams, offices and use cases, and support account managers in further growing the customer accounts.
* **Shape the product.** Bring structured insight from the field to product and engineering, so what we build next is what customers need.
* **Build the playbook.** Our deployment function is young. You'll define how Endra rolls out, measures and reports, and set the standard the team scales on.

**Who you are**

* You've run or played a key role in enterprise software rollouts, with 3–5 years of client-facing experience in customer success, implementation or management consulting, ideally in a complex, expert-driven industry.
* You've driven change management before and know that getting a large organization onto new technology is as much about people as about software.
* You're structured and organized, and you stay calm when there are many moving parts.
* You take ownership, and your track record shows it in results delivered and responsibilities that grew.
* You have commercial instinct. You know adoption drives renewal and expansion, and you think about the customer's business case, not only usage numbers.
* You're an excellent communicator, in writing and in the room, and a team player who makes the people around you better.
* You’re comfortable building as you go, improving a playbook rather than just following it.

**How we think and work**

* Less is more: We simplify and ship smaller, fast.
* Build the right things: We listen carefully and build what users actually need.
* Velocity & Quality: We build things that last, but we don’t perfect them forever.
* Trust & Collaboration: Strong opinions, loosely held.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and equity.
* Employee-friendly equity terms.
* Private health insurance.
* Regular team events and off-sites.
* An inspiring, ambitious, and global work environment.

**Ready to move the needle?**

Do you feel this is your opportunity to do your most meaningful work and reshape an entire industry? Let's talk!

**The Role**

This is a full-time role based in London. As an Operations Senior Analyst, you will be a part of the Sixth Street Global Operations Team and be involved in several facets of operations, including private investment execution, counterparty management, pipeline and other cash management functions, and reporting and investment performance/analysis deliverables. The Operations Team supports Sixth Street’s investing activities across the globe for our private credit/equity, hybrid, and liquid credit funds, business development companies, and separately managed accounts. * Work on our deal execution efforts, including:

  + Transaction settlement
  + Transaction and position booking and monitoring
  + Exits and restructurings
  + Risk reporting
  + Foreign exchange hedging
  + Bank account management
  + Coordination with counterparties and external partners

* Work with external service providers to ensure tax structuring and compliance requirements are met
* Assist with the development and production of daily and monthly reporting that is distributed to all levels of Sixth Street
Participate in a wide variety of special projects, both operational and financial

* Highly motivated, entrepreneurial, and team-oriented candidates with strong communication, presentation, and Excel skills
* Commercial and Results Orientation
* High Trust and Integrity
Strong combination of organizational and interpersonal/communication skills  

  

**Preferred**

* Candidates would possess a minimum of 5-6 years of experience. Experience should include middle and/or back-office operations at a buy-side organization that invests in private, highly structured transactions – those seen at a private equity or private credit alternative asset management firm or investment bank
* Experience with Advent Geneva and/or Allvue is a plus
* Operations experience within the Real Estate asset class would be beneficial
* Self-starter who requires little direction
* Ability to multi-task and maintain composure in a high-volume environment

We do all this globally and as one unified team of investment and control-side

  

professionals working on behalf of our institutional investors and their beneficiaries around the world.

Company Description

  
  

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**

More about **our mission** and **what we offer**.

  
  

Job Description

  
  

We are looking for a Lead Data Analyst who is passionate about our mission of Money Without Borders. You will partner with our Customer Support organisation to help drive data-driven decisions that improve customer outcomes while managing cost to serve and team capacity.

Customer Support is the largest customer-facing area in Servicing. It is where cost to serve, AI and automation, and the alignment between Operations and Product come together. You will measure whether changes to channels, self-serve flows and AI agents are working for customers, and you will be a trusted analytical voice for CS Operations, CS Product and WFM.

As a Lead Data Analyst, you will own key parts of the customer support metric tree, measure the impact of automation and AI, and run experiments and causal analyses that show what really changed. You will also help make sure the team's metrics are defined once, owned clearly and trusted by everyone who uses them.

This is a great opportunity for an analyst who has a keen understanding of customer problems, strong product thinking and is passionate about creating convincing analyses. You will also be part of the Servicing Analytics community of 86 analysts and a wider community of 150+ analysts at Wise, where you can collaborate on cross-team projects, share knowledge and help improve how analytics works across the company.

This is an IC3 role. .

* Collaborate with senior stakeholders across Customer Support and effectively communicate your insights into real change for our customers. Join us in working towards our mission.
* Own key areas of the CS metric tree, for example contact rate, first response, resolution, CSAT, repeat contact and cost per contact, and make sure they roll up cleanly into Servicing's Cost and Convenience toplines.
* Support target-setting and tracking with Ops and Product leaders, so the team can see whether targets are being hit, not just set them.

* Monitor automation quality. Support calibration and drift monitoring on quality scoring so automated decisions stay trustworthy.
* Support capacity planning and forecasting with WFM, including demand forecasts, staffing models, SLA and wait-time trade-offs, and regional and outsourcing mix.

Qualifications

* You have strong quantitative skills. Ideally a background in statistics, mathematics, physics, engineering, analytics, computing, or any other scientific areas.

* You have experience with data visualisation tools (Looker, PowerBI, Tableau etc.) and demonstrate confident storytelling ability with data.

We are looking for an experienced Hardware Asset Management (HAM) Data Analyst to take ownership of the quality, accuracy and integrity of hardware asset data across the full asset lifecycle. This is a key role within the IT Asset Management function, providing trusted data to support financial, contractual, operational, security and compliance decisions. You will work across Asset Management, Configuration Management, Procurement, Finance, IT Operations and suppliers to ensure hardware asset information is accurate, reconciled, auditable and continuously improved. This is not simply a data entry role. You will proactively identify data quality issues, reconcile information across multiple systems, investigate discrepancies and drive improvements in the maturity and reliability of the hardware asset estate.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Own and maintain the quality and integrity of hardware asset records across ITAM tools, CMDBs and associated systems.
* Perform regular data quality audits and reconciliations, identifying duplicates, missing records, ghost assets, unmanaged assets and data discrepancies.
* Reconcile asset information across ITAM, CMDB, discovery, procurement and financial systems.
* Maintain accurate asset data throughout the full lifecycle, from procurement and deployment through to redeployment and disposal.
* Produce asset reports, dashboards and data quality KPIs covering inventory, lifecycle status, warranties, EOL/EOS, utilisation and compliance.
* Support financial reconciliation between the IT asset register and Finance's fixed asset register, including capitalisation, depreciation and cost information.
* Maintain accurate procurement, vendor, warranty and support contract information.
* Support internal and external audits, providing accurate data, evidence and audit trails.
* Work with operational and technical teams to improve discovery coverage and resolve data discrepancies.
* Develop and maintain data standards, validation rules, naming conventions and governance processes.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement to reduce manual effort and improve data accuracy.
* Provide clear, actionable insight and recommendations to HAM/ITAM leadership and wider stakeholders.

**What you'll bring**

  

* Experience in IT Asset Management, Hardware Asset Management, CMDB or Configuration Management data roles.
* Strong data analysis skills with experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources.
* Experience using ITAM or asset management tools such as ServiceNow ITAM/HAM, Flexera, Snow, Ivanti or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of the hardware asset lifecycle, from procurement through to disposal.
* Experience reconciling data across ITAM, CMDB, discovery, procurement and financial systems.
* Advanced Excel skills and experience with reporting/visualisation tools such as Power BI, SQL or equivalent.
* Experience producing asset reports, dashboards and data quality metrics.
* Excellent attention to detail and a strong focus on data accuracy and integrity.
* Understanding of data governance, data standards, validation and audit requirements.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain data issues and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Desirable**

  

* IAITAM certification such as CHAMP, CSAM or CITAM.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or equivalent.
* Experience with ServiceNow HAM/ITAM and automated discovery tools such as ServiceNow Discovery, Tanium, SCCM, Qualys or Lansweeper.
* Knowledge of ISO 19770 IT Asset Management standards.
* Understanding of financial asset management, including depreciation, capitalisation, book value and TCO.
* Experience supporting audits and compliance activities.
* Knowledge of environmental disposal requirements such as WEEE.
* SQL, PowerShell or scripting experience.
* Experience working in secure, regulated or defence environments.

new_jobs.description:
The global privacy regulatory landscape is not static, and the product and technical landscape at Meta changes multiple times daily to continue to meet and meet the needs of our more than 3.5 billion daily users on our platform. The Compliance Assurance Program Manager (CAPM) works at the center of privacy regulation, legal, business, product, and engineering to put our users' privacy at the center of everything we do.The Exam & Audit (E&A) team, part of Meta's Regulatory Compliance Program (RCP), manages Meta's regulatory examination and audit engagements. E&A connects internal stakeholders with external assessors and regulators. Its work includes delivering external assessor testing on time and at quality, defending the program's position on findings, and driving remediation of identified gaps. As the second line of defense, E&A also gives compliance advice and independent oversight of Meta's privacy safeguards. It challenges their design and effectiveness so that compliance becomes a catalyst for trusted, responsible product growth rather than a constraint.This role sits in the Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) domain. TPRM covers the safeguards that govern how third parties (developers, partners, vendors and service providers) access, use and protect Meta user data. The CAPM will be the second-line partner for these safeguards and will lead their readiness for independent assessment.We are looking for an individual contributor who brings audit, risk, and privacy expertise to serve as a trusted second-line advisor and assessment lead for third-party safeguards. new_jobs.title: Customer Deployment Manager
new_jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
new_jobs.description:
**About Endra**

Every building is designed twice. The architect shapes what you see. MEP engineers design everything that makes it work: the power, air and water behind every hospital, data centre and home. It's a $150 billion industry still run on manual work and decades-old tools, and it's running out of engineers just as the world needs more buildings than ever.

We're building the platform that changes that. Endra's takes over the repetitive work so engineers can do what they're trained for: judgment and design. Some of the world's most respected engineering firms, including AtkinsRéalis, Ramboll, Buro Happold, Hoare Lea, Tetra Tech, AFRY and Rejlers, already build with us.

Since 2024, we've raised $75 million from Andreessen Horowitz, Notion Capital and Norrsken VC, and grown into a team across Stockholm, Zurich, London, New York and San Francisco. We're early, moving fast and setting out to change how the world's buildings get designed.

We're looking for people who care deeply about their craft, take ownership of complex problems, push us to think bigger, and are driven to create something with lasting impact.

**About the role**

For us, a signed contract is the starting line. The moment a customer signs, Customer Deployment takes over, and our job is to make Endra the way their engineers actually work as soon as possible.

As Customer Deployment Manager, you'll own that journey for some of our most important customers: large engineering consultancies with many offices, hundreds of engineers, and a long list of stakeholders who all need to say yes. You'll be the project lead for each rollout. You set up the structure, drive adoption, clear the roadblocks, and make the value impossible to miss.

You'll work hand in hand with our product specialists who are MEP engineers: they bring the MEP depth, you bring the structure and the commercial lens. Together you'll help engineers who have worked the same way for decades adopt a new one.

**What you'll do**.

* **Own onboarding and rollout.** Lead on-site and remote onboarding with our product specialists so MEP engineers get up and running fast and deliver real results using Endra on their very first project. You own the plan and the milestones, and you keep every stakeholder moving.
* **Work every stakeholder.** Cover everyone from the CEO and heads of discipline to BIM managers, IT and the engineers on the project. Keep them involved at the right moments, and turn early users into champions who train their colleagues.
* **Measure and report the wins.** Agree on success criteria with each customer, track adoption and account health, and act on risk early. Turn the results into clear wins for their leadership and for Endra.
* **Clear the roadblocks.** Spot what's stalling early, whether it's technical, organizational, or a skeptical team. Bring in the right people and see it through.
* **Find the next opportunity.** Uncover new teams, offices and use cases, and support account managers in further growing the customer accounts.
* **Shape the product.** Bring structured insight from the field to product and engineering, so what we build next is what customers need.
* **Build the playbook.** Our deployment function is young. You'll define how Endra rolls out, measures and reports, and set the standard the team scales on.

**Who you are**

* You've run or played a key role in enterprise software rollouts, with 3–5 years of client-facing experience in customer success, implementation or management consulting, ideally in a complex, expert-driven industry.
* You've driven change management before and know that getting a large organization onto new technology is as much about people as about software.
* You're structured and organized, and you stay calm when there are many moving parts.
* You take ownership, and your track record shows it in results delivered and responsibilities that grew.
* You have commercial instinct. You know adoption drives renewal and expansion, and you think about the customer's business case, not only usage numbers.
* You're an excellent communicator, in writing and in the room, and a team player who makes the people around you better.
* You’re comfortable building as you go, improving a playbook rather than just following it.

**How we think and work**

* Less is more: We simplify and ship smaller, fast.
* Build the right things: We listen carefully and build what users actually need.
* Velocity & Quality: We build things that last, but we don’t perfect them forever.
* Trust & Collaboration: Strong opinions, loosely held.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and equity.
* Employee-friendly equity terms.
* Private health insurance.
* Regular team events and off-sites.
* An inspiring, ambitious, and global work environment.

**Ready to move the needle?**

Do you feel this is your opportunity to do your most meaningful work and reshape an entire industry? Let's talk!

Compensation Range: $140K - $190K

Summary
  
  
The difference between data and intelligence is context. This role enriches data with business context to produce insights that enable intelligent decisions. Join Apple's Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization, the engine powering Apple. As a member of the Employee Productivity & Support Data Science team, you will use data to improve how Apple's internal productivity tools and platforms evolve. You will pull and prepare data from multiple systems, build dashboards and visualizations, and conduct analyses that help product leaders understand adoption, engagement, and portfolio performance. This role is about interpreting data, extracting insights, and partnering closely with the business to turn those insights into better decisions.
  
  
Description
  
  
In this role, you will support IS&T's Product group by building and maintaining the analytical assets it relies on — dashboards, reports, and ad-hoc analyses that surface how Apple's internal productivity tools are performing across the portfolio. You will draw on your expertise in product analytics to understand how employees use internal tools, identify where the experience can improve, and develop metrics that measure adoption, engagement, and value delivery. A core part of the role is partnership: you will work directly with product leaders and program managers to understand their challenges, translate them into analytical work, and deliver findings that are clear, accurate, and actionable. You are not building in isolation — you are a thought partner who understands the business well enough to know what to measure and why it matters. Day to day, you will write SQL to model data from large datasets, build and maintain Tableau dashboards, conduct analyses to identify trends and anomalies, and present your findings to stakeholders at various levels — all while using AI tools to accelerate your analytical work. The ideal candidate is someone who is technically strong, detail-oriented, and equally motivated by the work the data enables as by the data itself.

new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**
------------

At the County of Marin, our employees overwhelmingly report feeling their work is meaningful, they like the work they do, and they are proud to tell people “I work for the County of Marin.” Discover more about us, our values and our organizational culture on the Department of Human Resources website. Read on to find out more about this opportunity.

The mission of the Marin County Department of Public Works is To provide quality services and maintain and improve public infrastructure and facilities, while protecting Marin’s natural resources. Read more about the Department of Public Works at https://publicworks.marincounty.gov/.

**ABOUT THE POSITION**
----------------------

**Flex recruitment:**  
There are currently three (3) full-time, regular hire Capital Planning and Project Manager I/II (CPPM I/II) vacancies in the Capital Projects Division. Candidates will be considered for the level they meet minimum qualifications.

Working under the direction of the Capital Division Manager and in coordination with senior project management staff, the Capital Planning and Project Manager I and II positions support the delivery of Capital Improvement Projects from the planning and design phases through construction and project closeout. These positions provide project coordination and management support to help ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, within approved budgets and schedules, and in accordance with applicable requirements.

The Capital Planning and Project Manager I and II work closely with County project managers, design consultants, contractors, internal departments, and other project stakeholders in the delivery of Capital Projects. Responsibilities include assisting with the development and coordination of Request for Proposals from design consultants and other vendors, documenting design progress meetings, developing contract documents, uploading documents to an online bidding platform and overseeing the contract award process with administrative staff.

These positions help monitor project progress, schedules, budgets, and compliance with state-mandated safety requirements, and work with project team members to identify and address issues that may affect successful project delivery.

This is an excellent opportunity to build a career in capital project management while gaining hands-on experience with planning, coordination, construction, and closeout of projects that make a meaningful difference in the community. Successful candidates will have the opportunity to develop valuable project management skills, work alongside experienced professionals, and take on increasing levels of responsibility as their knowledge and expertise grow.

  
  
**Hybrid schedule:**

The Department of Public Works has embraced a **hybrid work schedule** that considers that some duties of this position may be performed remotely for up to two (2) business days per workweek. However, the successful candidate must be able to report to County facilities for meetings, work assignments, and/or disaster service work upon short notice, as needed and deemed appropriate. During the initial probationary period, the successful candidate may be required to work primarily onsite before establishing a hybrid work schedule.

**Application Timeline:** We look forward to reviewing your application! Please mark your calendar, the filing period for this recruitment will be open from Friday, November 13th, 2026, at 7:00 AM, through the closing date of Monday, November 16th, 2026, at 11:59 PM. You will be able to access the "Apply" function during this time only.

-------------

Our ideal CPPM I and II bring 1–3 years of hands-on experience in moderately complex capital and facilities-planning projects, with some experience in design team coordination, bid solicitation, contract award, and progress documentation. The ideal CPPM I and II will have the ability to successfully collaborate across County departments and stakeholder groups through clear, respectful communication.

  
  

Exceptionally organized, they maintain precise project documentation and distill technical and financial details into concise reports for leadership and public audiences. A resourceful problem-solver, they anticipate site-level challenges and implement compliant, cost-effective solutions, taking ownership from kickoff through closeout while adapting seamlessly between remote and onsite work.

Above all, they share our commitment to stewardship, integrity, and continuous improvement, delivering public facilities that truly serve the community.
